title: Oracle Database 12c Security Cookbook
description:
Oracle Database 12c Security Cookbook is your essential guide to mastering the security features in Oracle Database 12c. Through a clear and practical approach, this book provides step-by-step recipes to secure your database against contemporary vulnerabilities, ensuring that your data remains safe and protected.

What this Book will help me do

Identify and apply the right security strategies for various Oracle Database use cases.
Understand and implement Oracle Data Redaction and Virtual Private Database to protect sensitive data.
Utilize privilege analysis to strengthen database security and reduce attack surfaces.
Set up and enforce unified auditing to monitor user activities effectively.
Learn the best practices for multi-layer database security strategies in real-world scenarios.

Author(s)

Maja Veselica and Zoran Pavlovic are experienced database administrators and architects with years of expertise in Oracle Database environments. They bring a meticulous and holistic approach to troubleshooting and solution development. Through their books, they aim to empower professionals with the tools and knowledge needed to excel in database management.

Who is it for?

This book is perfect for database administrators, developers, and architects who want a practical guide on securing Oracle Database 12c. Beginners can grasp fundamental security concepts, whereas intermediate practitioners will gain insights into advanced topics. It's ideal for those striving to implement robust security measures in their Oracle environments.

Entiende e implementa Oracle Data Redaction y Virtual Private Database para proteger datos sensibles.
Utilizar análisis de privilegios para fortalecer la seguridad de la base de datos y reducir las superficies de ataque.

Aprende las mejores prácticas para las estrategias de seguridad de bases de datos multicapa en escenarios reales.

Este libro es perfecto para administradores de bases de datos, desarrolladores y arquitectos que quieren una guía práctica para asegurar Oracle Database 12c. Los principiantes pueden comprender conceptos fundamentales de seguridad, mientras que los practicantes intermedios obtendrán información sobre temas avanzados. Es ideal para aquellos que se esfuerzan por implementar medidas de seguridad robustas en sus entornos Oracle.

title: Self-Service Analytics
description:
Organizations today are swimming in data, but most of them manage to analyze only a fraction of what they collect. To help build a stronger data-driven culture, many organizations are adopting a new approach called self-service analytics. This O’Reilly report examines how this approach provides data access to more people across a company, allowing business users to work with data themselves and create their own customized analyses. The result? More eyes looking at more data in more ways.

Along with the perceived benefits, author Sandra Swanson also delves into the potential pitfalls of self-service analytics: balancing greater data access with concerns about security, data governance, and siloed data stores. Read this report and gain insights from enterprise tech (Yahoo), government (the City of Chicago), and disruptive retail (Warby Parker and Talend). Learn how these organizations are handling self-service analytics in practice.

Sandra Swanson is a Chicago-based writer who’s covered technology, science, and business for dozens of publications, including ScientificAmerican.com. Connect with her on Twitter (@saswanson) or at www.saswanson.com.
translatedDescription:
Las organizaciones de hoy nadan en datos, pero la mayoría de ellas logran analizar sólo una fracción de lo que recogen. Para ayudar a crear una cultura basada en datos más fuerte, muchas organizaciones están adoptando un nuevo enfoque llamado análisis de autoservicio. Este informe O’Reilly examina cómo este enfoque proporciona acceso a datos a más personas de toda una empresa, permitiendo a los usuarios de negocios trabajar con datos propios y crear sus propios análisis personalizados. ¿El resultado? Más ojos mirando más datos de más maneras.

Junto con los beneficios percibidos, la autora Sandra Swanson también profundiza en los posibles obstáculos de la analítica de autoservicio: equilibrar un mayor acceso a los datos con preocupaciones sobre seguridad, gobernanza de datos y tiendas de datos silenciadas. Lea este informe y obtenga información de la tecnología empresarial (Yahoo), el gobierno (la ciudad de Chicago), y el retail disruptivo (Warby Parker y Talend). Aprenda cómo estas organizaciones están manejando análisis de autoservicio en la práctica.

Sandra Swanson es una escritora de Chicago que cubre tecnología, ciencia y negocios para docenas de publicaciones, incluyendo ScientificAmerican.com. Conéctate en Twitter (@saswanson) o en www.saswanson.com.

title: Introduction to Stochastic Analysis: Integrals and Differential Equations
description:
This is an introduction to stochastic integration and stochastic differential equations written in an understandable way for a wide audience, from students of mathematics to practitioners in biology, chemistry, physics, and finances. The presentation is based on the naïve stochastic integration, rather than on abstract theories of measure and stochastic processes. The proofs are rather simple for practitioners and, at the same time, rather rigorous for mathematicians. Detailed application examples in natural sciences and finance are presented. Much attention is paid to simulation diffusion processes.

The topics covered include Brownian motion; motivation of stochastic models with Brownian motion; Itô and Stratonovich stochastic integrals, Itô's formula; stochastic differential equations (SDEs); solutions of SDEs as Markov processes; application examples in physical sciences and finance; simulation of solutions of SDEs (strong and weak approximations). Exercises with hints and/or solutions are also provided.
translatedDescription:
Esta es una introducción a la integración estocástica y las ecuaciones diferenciales estocásticas escritas de manera comprensible para un amplio público, desde estudiantes de matemáticas a practicantes en biología, química, física y finanzas. La presentación se basa en la ingenua integración estocástica, en lugar de en teorías abstractas de medida y procesos estocásticos. Las pruebas son bastante simples para los practicantes y, al mismo tiempo, bastante rigurosas para los matemáticos. Se presentan ejemplos detallados de aplicaciones en ciencias naturales y finanzas. Se presta mucha atención a los procesos de difusión de simulación.

Los temas tratados incluyen movimiento marroniano; motivación de modelos estocásticos con movimiento marroniano; integrales estocásticos Itô y Stratonovich, fórmula de Itô; ecuaciones diferenciales estocásticas (SDEs); soluciones de SDEs como procesos Markov; ejemplos de aplicaciones en ciencias físicas y finanzas; simulación de soluciones de SDEs (aspecto fuerte y débil). También se proporcionan ejercicios con consejos y/o soluciones.

title: Knowledge Automation: How to Implement Decision Management in Business Processes
description:
A proven decision management methodology for increased profits and lowered risks

Knowledge Automation: How to Implement Decision Management in Business Processes describes a simple but comprehensive methodology for decision management projects, which use business rules and predictive analytics to optimize and automate small, high-volume business decisions. It includes Decision Requirements Analysis (DRA), a new method for taking the crucial first step in any IT project to implement decision management: defining a set of business decisions and identifying all the information—business knowledge and data—required to make those decisions.

Describes all the stages in automating business processes, from business process modeling down to the implementation of decision services

Addresses how to use business rules and predictive analytics to optimize and automate small, high-volume business decisions

Proposes a simple "top-down" method for defining decision requirements and representing them in a single diagram

Shows how clear requirements can allow decision management projects to be run with reduced risk and increased profit

Nontechnical and accessible, Knowledge Automation reveals how DRA is destined to become a standard technique in the business analysis and project management toolbox.
translatedDescription:
Una metodología probada de gestión de decisiones para aumentar las ganancias y reducir los riesgos

Automatización del conocimiento: Cómo implementar la gestión de decisiones en procesos empresariales describe una metodología simple pero integral para proyectos de gestión de decisiones, que utilizan reglas de negocio y analítica predictiva para optimizar y automatizar decisiones de negocios pequeñas y de alto volumen. Incluye el Análisis de Requisitos de Decisiones (DRA), un nuevo método para tomar el primer paso crucial en cualquier proyecto de TI para implementar la gestión de decisiones: definir un conjunto de decisiones de negocios e identificar toda la información — conocimientos empresariales y datos— necesaria para tomar esas decisiones.

Describe todas las etapas en los procesos de automatización de las empresas, desde el modelado de procesos institucionales hasta la implementación de los servicios de decisión

Aborda cómo utilizar las reglas de negocio y la analítica predictiva para optimizar y automatizar decisiones de negocios pequeñas y de alto volumen

Propone un método simple "top-down" para definir los requisitos de decisión y representarlos en un solo diagrama

Muestra cómo los requisitos claros pueden permitir que los proyectos de gestión de decisiones se ejecuten con menor riesgo y mayores beneficios

No técnico y accesible, Knowledge Automation revela cómo DRA está destinada a convertirse en una técnica estándar en el análisis de negocios y la herramienta de gestión de proyectos.

title: Matlab® in Bioscience and Biotechnology
description:
MATLAB® in bioscience and biotechnology presents an introductory Matlab course oriented towards various collaborative areas of biotechnology and bioscience. It concentrates on Matlab fundamentals and gives examples of its application to a wide range of current bioengineering problems in computational biology, molecular biology, bio-kinetics, biomedicine, bioinformatics, and biotechnology. In the last decade Matlab has been presented to students as the first computer program they learn. Consequently, many non-programmer students, engineers and scientists have come to regard it as user-friendly and highly convenient in solving their specific problems. Numerous books are available on programming in Matlab for engineers in general, irrespective of their specialization, or for those specializing in some specific area, but none have been designed especially for such a wide, interdisciplinary, and topical area as bioengineering. Thus, in this book, Matlab is presented with examples and applications to various school-level and advanced bioengineering problems - from growing populations of microorganisms and population dynamics, reaction kinetics and reagent concentrations, predator-prey models, mass-transfer and flow problems, to sequence analysis and sequence statistics.
This is the first book intended as a manual introducing biologists and other biotechnology engineers to work with Matlab
It is suitable for beginners and inexperienced users; however, applications of Matlab to advanced problems such as the Monte Carlo method, curve fitting, and reliable machine diagnostics make the book relevant to university teachers as well
The book is different in that it assumes a modest mathematical background for the reader and introduces the mathematical or technical concepts with a somewhat traditional approach; Matlab is then used as a tool for subsequent computer solution

Se concentra en los fundamentos de Matlab y da ejemplos de su aplicación a una amplia gama de problemas actuales de bioingeniería en biología computacional, biología molecular, biokinetics, biomedicina, bioinformática y biotecnología. En la última década Matlab ha sido presentado a los estudiantes como el primer programa informático que aprenden. En consecuencia, muchos estudiantes, ingenieros y científicos no productores han llegado a considerarlo como fácil de usar y muy conveniente para resolver sus problemas específicos. Numerosos libros están disponibles sobre programación en Matlab para ingenieros en general, independientemente de su especialización, o para aquellos que se especializan en algún área específica, pero ninguno ha sido diseñado especialmente para un área tan amplia, interdisciplinaria y tópica como bioingeniería. Así, en este libro, Matlab se presenta con ejemplos y aplicaciones a diversos problemas de bioingeniería a nivel escolar y avanzado - de poblaciones crecientes de microorganismos y dinámicas demográficas, kinetics de reacción y concentraciones reactivas, modelos depredador-prey, problemas de transmisión masiva y flujo, a análisis de secuencias y estadísticas de secuencia.
Este es el primer libro destinado como manual introduciendo biólogos y otros ingenieros biotecnológicos para trabajar con Matlab
Es adecuado para principiantes y usuarios inexpertos; sin embargo, las aplicaciones de Matlab a problemas avanzados como el método Monte Carlo, el ajuste de curvas y el diagnóstico de máquina confiable hacen que el libro sea relevante para los profesores universitarios también
El libro es diferente en que asume un modesto fondo matemático para el lector e introduce los conceptos matemáticos o técnicos con un enfoque algo tradicional; Matlab se utiliza entonces como una herramienta para la solución informática posterior

title: Graphical Data Analysis with R
description: This book focuses on why one draws graphics to display data and which graphics to draw (and uses R to do so). Graphical data analysis is useful for data cleaning, exploring data structure, detecting outliers and unusual groups, identifying trends and clusters, spotting local patterns, evaluating modelling output, and presenting results. All the datasets are available in R or one of its packages and the R code is available online. Color graphics are used throughout the book.
translatedDescription: Este libro se centra en por qué se dibuja gráficos para mostrar datos y qué gráficos dibujar (y utiliza R para hacerlo). El análisis gráfico de datos es útil para la limpieza de datos, la exploración de la estructura de datos, la detección de outliers y grupos inusuales, la identificación de tendencias y clusters, la detección de patrones locales, la evaluación de la producción de modelado y la presentación de resultados. Todos los conjuntos de datos están disponibles en R o uno de sus paquetes y el código R está disponible en línea. Los gráficos de color se utilizan a lo largo del libro.

title: Microsoft® SQL Server® 2012 Analysis Services: The BISM Tabular Model
authors: Alberto Ferrari Marco Russo and Chris Webb
description:
Build agile and responsive Business Intelligence solutions

Analyze tabular data using the BI Semantic Model (BISM) in Microsoft SQL Server 2012 Analysis Services—and discover a simpler method for creating corporate-level BI solutions. Led by three BI experts, you’ll learn how to build, deploy, and query a BISM tabular model with step-by-step guides, examples, and best practices. This hands-on book shows you how the tabular model’s in-memory database enables you to perform rapid analytics—whether you’re a professional BI developer new to Analysis Services or familiar with its multidimensional model.

Discover how to:

Determine when a tabular or multidimensional model is right for your project

Build a tabular model using SQL Server Data Tools in Microsoft Visual Studio 2010

Integrate data from multiple sources into a single, coherent view of company information

Use the Data Analysis eXpressions (DAX) language to create calculated columns, measures, and queries

Choose a data modeling technique that meets your organization’s performance and usability requirements

Optimize your data model for better performance with xVelocity storage engine

Manage complex data relationships, such as multicolumn, banding, and many-to-many

Implement security by establishing administrative and data user roles

Analice los datos tabulares usando el Modelo Semántico BI (BISM) en Microsoft SQL Server 2012 Analysis Services, y descubra un método más simple para crear soluciones de IB a nivel corporativo. Dirigido por tres expertos de BI, aprenderás a construir, desplegar y consultar un modelo tabular BISM con guías paso a paso, ejemplos y mejores prácticas. Este libro práctico le muestra cómo la base de datos en memoria del modelo tabular le permite realizar análisis rápidos, ya sea que sea un desarrollador profesional de IB nuevo en Servicios de Análisis o familiarizado con su modelo multidimensional.

Optimize your data model for better performance with xVelocity storage engine

Gestionar complejas relaciones de datos, como multicolumn, bandas y muchas a muchas personas

Implementar la seguridad estableciendo funciones administrativas y de usuario de datos

title: TensorFlow Reinforcement Learning Quick Start Guide

Are you ready to explore the cutting-edge methods of training intelligent, self-learning agents? "TensorFlow Reinforcement Learning Quick Start Guide" introduces you to reinforcement learning concepts and provides step-by-step instructions to implement advanced algorithms using Python and TensorFlow. Through practical examples such as autonomous driving simulations and game-playing agents, you'll get a comprehensive understanding of RL.

What this Book will help me do

Master the fundamental principles and algorithms used in reinforcement learning.
Learn how to implement reinforcement learning models in Python and TensorFlow.
Understand how to design and train machine learning agents for solving control tasks.
Apply advanced algorithms like DQN, A3C, and PPO to OpenAI Gym problems.
Develop real-world use cases such as training an AI for autonomous vehicle control.

Author(s)

None Balakrishnan is a proficient developer and author with deep expertise in machine learning and artificial intelligence. His work focuses on simplifying complex algorithms and implementing them in practical use cases. Drawing from his extensive technical experience, None explains concepts clearly, ensuring readers understand the nuances of reinforcement learning and its applications.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for data scientists, machine learning practitioners, and AI enthusiasts eager to dive into reinforcement learning. Whether you're a beginner comfortable with Python or an experienced developer seeking to adopt TensorFlow for RL projects, this book will guide you through the process of developing and implementing RL systems effectively.

This book is ideal for data science professionals, software engineers, and IoT developers aiming to advance their AI and IoT expertise. title: Mining the Web
description: Mining the Web: Discovering Knowledge from Hypertext Data is the first book devoted entirely to techniques for producing knowledge from the vast body of unstructured Web data. Building on an initial survey of infrastructural issues—including Web crawling and indexing—Chakrabarti examines low-level machine learning techniques as they relate specifically to the challenges of Web mining. He then devotes the final part of the book to applications that unite infrastructure and analysis to bring machine learning to bear on systematically acquired and stored data. Here the focus is on results: the strengths and weaknesses of these applications, along with their potential as foundations for further progress. From Chakrabarti's work—painstaking, critical, and forward-looking—readers will gain the theoretical and practical understanding they need to contribute to the Web mining effort.* A comprehensive, critical exploration of statistics-based attempts to make sense of Web Mining.* Details the special challenges associated with analyzing unstructured and semi-structured data.* Looks at how classical Information Retrieval techniques have been modified for use with Web data.* Focuses on today's dominant learning methods: clustering and classification, hyperlink analysis, and supervised and semi-supervised learning.* Analyzes current applications for resource discovery and social network analysis.* An excellent way to introduce students to especially vital applications of data mining and machine learning technology.
translatedDescription: Mining the Web: Discovering Knowledge from Hypertext Data es el primer libro dedicado enteramente a técnicas para producir conocimiento del vasto cuerpo de datos Web no estructurados. Sobre la base de una encuesta inicial sobre cuestiones infraestructurales —incluyendo la rastreación e indexación de la Web—Chakrabarti examina técnicas de aprendizaje automático de bajo nivel, ya que se refieren específicamente a los desafíos de la minería de la Web. Luego dedica la parte final del libro a aplicaciones que unen la infraestructura y el análisis para llevar el aprendizaje automático a los datos adquiridos y almacenados sistemáticamente. Aquí se centra en los resultados: las fortalezas y debilidades de estas aplicaciones, junto con su potencial como fundamentos para un mayor progreso. Desde el trabajo de Chakrabarti —pintando, crítico y orientado hacia el futuro— los lectores ganarán el entendimiento teórico y práctico que necesitan para contribuir al esfuerzo minero de la Web.* Una exploración integral y crítica de intentos basados en estadísticas para tener sentido de la Minería Web.* Details the special challenges associated with analyzing unstructured and semi-structured data.* Mira cómo se han modificado las técnicas de recuperación de información clásica para su uso con datos Web.* Se centra en los métodos de aprendizaje dominantes de hoy: agrupación y clasificación, análisis de hipervínculos y aprendizaje supervisado y semisupervisado*. Analiza las aplicaciones actuales para el descubrimiento de recursos y el análisis de redes sociales*. Una excelente manera de introducir a los estudiantes en aplicaciones especialmente vitales de la minería de datos y la tecnología de aprendizaje automático.

title: Deep Learning and Its Applications for Vehicle Networks
description: This book is based on the work from world-famous experts on the application of DL for vehicle networks. It consists of the following five parts: 1. DL for vehicle safety and security, 2. DL for effective vehicle communications, 3. DL for vehicle control, 4. DL for information management, 5. Other applications.

DL para seguridad y seguridad de los vehículos, 2. DL para comunicaciones eficaces de vehículos, 3. DL para control de vehículos, 4. DL para gestión de la información, 5. Otras aplicaciones.

title: Autonomous Learning Systems: From Data Streams to Knowledge in Real-time
description:
Autonomous Learning Systems is the result of over a decade of focused research and studies in this emerging area which spans a number of well-known and well-established disciplines that include machine learning, system identification, data mining, fuzzy logic, neural networks, neuro-fuzzy systems, control theory and pattern recognition. The evolution of these systems has been both industry-driven with an increasing demand from sectors such as defence and security, aerospace and advanced process industries, bio-medicine and intelligent transportation, as well as research-driven – there is a strong trend of innovation of all of the above well-established research disciplines that is linked to their on-line and real-time application; their adaptability and flexibility.

Providing an introduction to the key technologies, detailed technical explanations of the methodology, and an illustration of the practical relevance of the approach with a wide range of applications, this book addresses the challenges of autonomous learning systems with a systematic approach that lays the foundations for a fast growing area of research that will underpin a range of technological applications vital to both industry and society.

Key features:

Presents the subject systematically from explaining the fundamentals to illustrating the proposed approach with numerous applications.

Covers a wide range of applications in fields including unmanned vehicles/robotics, oil refineries, chemical industry, evolving user behaviour and activity recognition.

Reviews traditional fields including clustering, classification, control, fault detection and anomaly detection, filtering and estimation through the prism of evolving and autonomously learning mechanisms.

Accompanied by a website hosting additional material, including the software toolbox and lecture notes.

Autonomous Learning Systems provides a 'one-stop shop' on the subject for academics, students, researchers and practicing engineers. It is also a valuable reference for Government agencies and software developers.
translatedDescription:
Los Sistemas de Aprendizaje Autónomo son el resultado de más de una década de investigación y estudios centrados en esta zona emergente que abarca una serie de disciplinas bien conocidas y bien establecidas que incluyen el aprendizaje automático, la identificación del sistema, la minería de datos, la lógica borrosa, las redes neuronales, los sistemas neuro-fuzzy, la teoría del control y el reconocimiento de patrones. La evolución de estos sistemas ha sido impulsada por la industria con una creciente demanda de sectores como la defensa y la seguridad, las industrias de procesos aeroespaciales y avanzados, la biomedicina y el transporte inteligente, así como la investigación impulsada – existe una fuerte tendencia de innovación de todas las disciplinas de investigación bien establecidas anteriormente vinculadas a su aplicación en línea y en tiempo real; su adaptabilidad y flexibilidad.

Proporcionar una introducción a las tecnologías clave, explicaciones técnicas detalladas de la metodología y una ilustración de la pertinencia práctica del enfoque con una amplia gama de aplicaciones, este libro aborda los desafíos de los sistemas de aprendizaje autónomos con un enfoque sistemático que sienta las bases para un área de investigación de rápido crecimiento que sustentará una gama de aplicaciones tecnológicas vitales tanto para la industria como para la sociedad.

Características clave:

Presenta el tema sistemáticamente de explicar los fundamentos a ilustrar el enfoque propuesto con numerosas aplicaciones.

Cubre una amplia gama de aplicaciones en campos como vehículos no tripulados/robotéticos, refinerías de petróleo, industria química, comportamiento cambiante de los usuarios y reconocimiento de actividades.

Revise los campos tradicionales incluyendo agrupación, clasificación, control, detección de fallas y detección de anomalías, filtración y estimación a través del prisma de los mecanismos de aprendizaje evolutivo y autónomo.

Acompañado por un sitio web que alberga material adicional, incluyendo la caja de herramientas de software y notas de conferencias.

Los Sistemas de Aprendizaje Autónomos ofrecen una "tienda única" sobre el tema para académicos, estudiantes, investigadores e ingenieros practicantes. It is also a valuable reference for Government agencies and software developers.

title: Oracle PL/SQL Programming: A Developer's Workbook
description:
However excellent they are, most computer books are inherently passive--readers simply take in text without having any opportunity to react to it. The Oracle PL/SQL Developer's Workbook is a different kind of animal! It's designed to engage you actively, to get you solving programming problems immediately, and to help you apply what you've learned about PL/SQL--and in the process deepen your knowledge of the language. By tackling the exercises in this workbook, you'll find yourself moving more rapidly along the learning curve to join the growing ranks of PL/SQL experts.The Oracle PL/SQL Developer's Workbook is a companion to Steven Feuerstein's bestselling Oracle PL/SQL Programming and his other PL/SQL books from O'Reilly. It contains a carefully constructed set of problems and solutions that will test your language skills and help you become a better developer--both with PL/SQL and with other languages. Exercises are provided at three levels: beginner, intermediate, and expert. The workbook exercises cover all the major features of PL/SQL, including those new to Oracle8i (e.g., Java and web features, autonomous transactions, and bulk binds).You'll find chapters on:

Basic language elements--variables, naming, loops, conditional and sequential control, exception handling, and records.
Data structures--index-by tables, nested tables, variables arrays (VARRAYs), and object technology.
Database interaction--cursors, DML and transaction management, cursor variables, and native dynamic SQL
Program construction--procedures, functions, blocks, packages, database triggers, and calling PL/SQL functions in SQL.
Built-in functionality--the character, date, conversion, numeric, and miscellaneous functions, and the DBMS_SQL, DBMS_PIPE, DBMS_OUTPUT, UTL_FILE, and DBMS_JOB built-in packages.
Miscellaneous topics--using Java with PL/SQL, external programs, PL/SQL web development, tuning PL/SQL, and PL/SQL for DBAs.

title: Web Database Applications with PHP, and MySQL
description: What do eBay, Amazon.com and CNN.com have in common? They're all applications that integrate large databases with the Web. The popularity (and power) of these applications stems from their accessibility and usability: thousands of users can access the same data at the same time without theneed to install any additional software on their computers. Web Database Applications with PHP and MySQL offers web developers a mixture of theoretical and practical information on creating web database applications. Using PHP, and MySQL, two open source technologies that are often combined to develop web applications, the book offers detailed information on designing relational databases and on web application architecture, both of which will be useful to readers who have never dealt with these issues before. The book also introduces Hugh and Dave's Online Wines, a complete (but fictional) online retail site that allows users to browse, search a database, add items to a shopping cart, manage their membership, and purchase wines. Using this site as an example, the book shows you how to implement searching and browsing, store user data, validate user input, manage transactions, and maintain security. If you want to build small to medium-scale web database applications that can run on modest hardware and process more than a million hits a day from users, this book will show you how.

Web Database Applications con PHP y MySQL ofrece a los desarrolladores web una mezcla de información teórica y práctica sobre la creación de aplicaciones de bases de datos web. Utilizando PHP, y MySQL, dos tecnologías de código abierto que a menudo se combinan para desarrollar aplicaciones web, el libro ofrece información detallada sobre el diseño de bases de datos relacionales y sobre la arquitectura de aplicaciones web, ambas de las cuales serán útiles para los lectores que nunca han tratado estos problemas antes. Si quieres construir aplicaciones de base de datos web pequeñas a medianas que puedan funcionar con hardware modesto y procesar más de un millón de visitas al día por parte de los usuarios, este libro te mostrará cómo.

title: Privacy-Preserving Machine Learning
description:
Keep sensitive user data safe and secure without sacrificing the performance and accuracy of your machine learning models. In Privacy Preserving Machine Learning, you will learn:
Privacy considerations in machine learning
Differential privacy techniques for machine learning
Privacy-preserving synthetic data generation
Privacy-enhancing technologies for data mining and database applications
Compressive privacy for machine learning
Privacy Preserving Machine Learning is a comprehensive guide to avoiding data breaches in your machine learning projects. You’ll get to grips with modern privacy-enhancing techniques such as differential privacy, compressive privacy, and synthetic data generation. Based on years of DARPA-funded cybersecurity research, ML engineers of all skill levels will benefit from incorporating these privacy-preserving practices into their model development. By the time you’re done reading, you’ll be able to create machine learning systems that preserve user privacy without sacrificing data quality and model performance.About the TechnologyMachine learning applications need massive amounts of data. It’s up to you to keep the sensitive information in those data sets private and secure. Privacy preservation happens at every point in the ML process, from data collection and ingestion to model development and deployment. This practical book teaches you the skills you’ll need to secure your data pipelines end to end.About the BookPrivacy Preserving Machine Learning explores privacy preservation techniques through real-world use cases in facial recognition, cloud data storage, and more. You’ll learn about practical implementations you can deploy now, future privacy challenges, and how to adapt existing technologies to your needs. Your new skills build towards a complete security data platform project you’ll develop in the final chapter.What's Inside
Differential and compressive privacy techniques
Privacy for frequency or mean estimation, naive Bayes classifier, and deep learning
Privacy-preserving synthetic data generation
Enhanced privacy for data mining and database applications
About the ReaderFor machine learning engineers and developers. Examples in Python and Java.About the AuthorsJ. Morris Chang is a professor at the University of South Florida. His research projects have been funded by DARPA and the DoD. Di Zhuang is a security engineer at Snap Inc. G. Dumindu Samaraweera is an assistant research professor at the University of South Florida. title: Learning Probabilistic Graphical Models in R
description:
Explore the fundamentals of probabilistic graphical models (PGM) with hands-on examples using R. This book helps you translate theoretical concepts into practical solutions, addressing complex problems with Bayesian and Markov networks. It's written to demystify PGMs, equipping you to create robust models for inference, learning, and prediction.

What this Book will help me do

Understand and implement probabilistic graphical models, including Bayesian and Markov networks, directly in R.
Learn to use various R packages for performing inference and analyzing probabilistic models.
Master the essentials of Bayesian methods, transitioning to advanced concepts with clear, step-by-step guidance.
Familiarize yourself with methods like PCA and ICA for analyzing and reducing complex data dimensions.
Develop practical skills to apply PGM techniques to machine learning challenges and real-world data problems.

Author(s)

The authors bring diverse expertise in probabilistic modeling, R programming, and applied machine learning. They are passionate educators and technical writers, focusing on breaking down complex theories into accessible knowledge. Their writing emphasizes practical demonstration, leveraging their industry and academic experiences.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for data scientists, engineers, and machine learning enthusiasts who wish to enhance their understanding of probabilistic graphical models. Whether you're curious about Bayesian methods or looking to apply PGM approaches to data-rich challenges, this guide is perfect for learners at an intermediate level, offering practical insights and real-world applications.
translatedDescription:
Explore los fundamentos de los modelos gráficos probabilísticos (PGM) con ejemplos prácticos utilizando R. Este libro le ayuda a traducir conceptos teóricos en soluciones prácticas, abordando problemas complejos con las redes Bayesian y Markov. Está escrito para desmitificar las MGP, equiparle para crear modelos robustos para la inferencia, el aprendizaje y la predicción.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Comprender e implementar modelos gráficos probabilísticos, incluyendo las redes Bayesian y Markov, directamente en R.
Aprende a usar varios paquetes R para realizar modelos probabilísticos de inferencia y análisis.
Domine los elementos esenciales de los métodos Bayesianos, pasando a conceptos avanzados con una orientación clara y gradual.
Familiarícese con métodos como PCA y ICA para analizar y reducir dimensiones complejas de datos.
Desarrollar habilidades prácticas para aplicar técnicas de PGM a retos de aprendizaje automático y problemas de datos del mundo real.

Autor(s)

Los autores aportan diversa experiencia en modelado probabilístico, programación R y aprendizaje automático aplicado. Son educadores apasionados y escritores técnicos, centrándose en romper teorías complejas en conocimiento accesible. Su escritura enfatiza la demostración práctica, aprovechando su industria y experiencias académicas.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro está diseñado para científicos de datos, ingenieros y entusiastas del aprendizaje automático que desean mejorar su comprensión de los modelos gráficos probabilísticos. Si usted tiene curiosidad acerca de los métodos Bayesian o busca aplicar enfoques PGM a los desafíos ricos en datos, esta guía es perfecta para los estudiantes a nivel intermedio, ofreciendo ideas prácticas y aplicaciones del mundo real.

title: Web Analytics Action Hero: Using Analysis to Gain Insight and Optimize Your Business
description:
Companies need more than just web analysts and data-savvy marketers to be successful–they need action heroes! While most of us never battle evil scientists or defuse nuclear warheads, successful web analysts benefit from the same attributes that fictional action heroes embody. As a web analyst, your main goal is to improve your organization’s online performance. You can become an “action hero” by translating analysis insights into action that generates significant returns for your company. How you approach analysis is critical to your overall success. In this book, web analytics expert Brent Dykes addresses the unique challenges facing analysts and online marketers working within small and large companies, teaching you how to move beyond reporting and toward analysis to drive action and change. Taking a principle-based rather than a tool-specific approach, Brent introduces you to the Action Hero Framework that breaks down the analysis process into three key stages: Prioritize (what to analyze), Analyze (how to analyze), and Mobilize (how to drive action). And he reinforces these topics with real-world examples and practical tips from seasoned analysts at leading companies.

Defines the type of environment in which action heroes thrive–not just survive–as well as how to defeat the villains of web analytics that stand in the way

Arms web professionals with a strategic framework for executing online analysis, as well as an arsenal of analysis techniques

Reveals how companies need to be both data-driven and action-agile to drive business value from web analytics

For more action hero resources and information, check out the book’s companion site at www.Analyticshero.com. "The ideas in this book will take you days (or even weeks) to work your way through, and they fly in the face of the emotional approach to marketing. The question is: would you rather have your competition lead the way with data and science when it comes to reaching your market, or are you going to go first? That's how it is with action heroes--no guts, no glory."   -Seth Godin Author We Are All Weird "Don't let the jaunty, breezy style of this book throw you off. Brent successfully - and entertainingly - packs years of experience into these pages along with case studies and insightful help on getting the most out of web analytics, adding value to your company and boosting your career trajectory." -Jim Sterne Founder of eMetrics Marketing Optimization Summit, author of "Social Media Metrics" and Chairman of the Digital Analytics Association

Como analista web, su objetivo principal es mejorar el rendimiento online de su organización. Usted puede convertirse en un “héroe de acción” traduciendo ideas de análisis en la acción que genera rendimientos significativos para su empresa. Cómo se aborda el análisis es crítico para su éxito general. En este libro, el experto en analítica web Brent Dykes aborda los desafíos únicos que enfrentan los analistas y los marketers en línea que trabajan dentro de pequeñas y grandes empresas, enseñándole cómo ir más allá de la presentación y hacia el análisis para impulsar la acción y el cambio. Tomando un enfoque basado en principios en lugar de un enfoque específico de herramientas, Brent le presenta el Marco de Acción Hero que descompone el proceso de análisis en tres etapas clave: Priorizar (qué analizar), analizar (cómo analizar), y Mobilizar (cómo impulsar la acción). Y refuerza estos temas con ejemplos reales y consejos prácticos de analistas experimentados en empresas líderes.

Define el tipo de ambiente en el que los héroes de acción prosperan – no sólo sobreviven– así como cómo derrotar a los villanos de analítica web que se interponen en el camino

Arms web professionals with a strategic framework for executing online analysis, as well as an arsenal of analysis techniques

Revela cómo las empresas necesitan ser tanto basadas en datos como ágiles de acción para impulsar el valor de negocio de la analítica web

title: Computational Intelligence and Pattern Analysis in Biological Informatics
description:
An invaluable tool in Bioinformatics, this unique volume provides both theoretical and experimental results, and describes basic principles of computational intelligence and pattern analysis while deepening the reader's understanding of the ways in which these principles can be used for analyzing biological data in an efficient manner.

This book synthesizes current research in the integration of computational intelligence and pattern analysis techniques, either individually or in a hybridized manner. The purpose is to analyze biological data and enable extraction of more meaningful information and insight from it. Biological data for analysis include sequence data, secondary and tertiary structure data, and microarray data. These data types are complex and advanced methods are required, including the use of domain-specific knowledge for reducing search space, dealing with uncertainty, partial truth and imprecision, efficient linear and/or sub-linear scalability, incremental approaches to knowledge discovery, and increased level and intelligence of interactivity with human experts and decision makers

Chapters authored by leading researchers in CI in biology informatics.

Covers highly relevant topics: rational drug design; analysis of microRNAs and their involvement in human diseases.

Supplementary material included: program code and relevant data sets correspond to chapters.

Note: The ebook version does not provide access to the companion files.

Capítulos autorizados por investigadores líderes en CI en biología informática.

Develop predictive models for time series and risk management.
Implement advanced trading strategies tailored to current market conditions.
Master simulation techniques for scenarios without analytical solutions.
Evaluate portfolio risks and potential returns with advanced methods.

title: The Smart Nonprofit
description:
A pragmatic framework for nonprofit digital transformation that embraces the human-centered nature of your organization

In The Smart Nonprofit: Staying Human-Centered in an Automated World, a team of dedicated nonprofit thought leaders delivers a discussion of the information and tools nonprofit staffers and board members need to effectively use artificial intelligence without alienating the human stakeholders and donors on whom they rely.

Each chapter of the book offers a narrative discussion of how AI affects a particular functional area in an organization that includes case studies and practical tips for the ethical use of AI. You’ll discover explorations of:

The steps you need to take to become a smart nonprofit and how to effectively lead a digitally transformed organization
How to automate program delivery, fundraising, and the back office
Likely future developments in AI for nonprofit work, including a more diverse field of programmers and data scientists and data sovereignty

Perfect for nonprofit leaders, board members, employees, managers, and founders, The Smart Nonprofit also belongs on the bookshelves of anyone interested in the intersection of leadership and technology.

Cada capítulo del libro ofrece una discusión narrativa sobre cómo IA afecta un área funcional particular en una organización que incluye estudios de casos y consejos prácticos para el uso ético de IA. Usted descubrirá las exploraciones de:

Los pasos que necesita tomar para convertirse en una organización inteligente sin fines de lucro y cómo dirigir eficazmente una organización digital
Cómo automatizar la entrega del programa, recaudación de fondos y la oficina de atrás
Evolución de la labor sin fines de lucro en el futuro, incluida una esfera más diversa de programadores y científicos de datos y soberanía de datos

Perfecta para líderes sin fines de lucro, miembros de la junta directiva, empleados, gerentes y fundadores, The Smart Nonprofit también pertenece a las librerías de cualquiera interesado en la intersección de liderazgo y tecnología.

title: Pharmaceutical Quality by Design Using JMP
description:
Solve your pharmaceutical product development and manufacturing problems using JMP .Pharmaceutical Quality by Design Using JMP : Solving Product Development and Manufacturing Problems provides broad-based techniques available in JMP to visualize data and run statistical analyses for areas common in healthcare product manufacturing. As international regulatory agencies push the concept of Quality by Design (QbD), there is a growing emphasis to optimize the processing of products. This book uses practical examples from the pharmaceutical and medical device industries to illustrate easy-to-understand ways of incorporating QbD elements using JMP. Pharmaceutical Quality by Design Using JMP opens by demonstrating the easy navigation of JMP to visualize data through the distribution function and the graph builder and then highlights the following:
the powerful dynamic nature of data visualization that enables users to be able to quickly extract meaningful information
tools and techniques designed for the use of structured, multivariate sets of experiments
examples of complex analysis unique to healthcare products such as particle size distributions/drug dissolution, stability of drug products over time, and blend uniformity/content uniformity.

Scientists, engineers, and technicians involved throughout the pharmaceutical and medical device product life cycles will find this book invaluable.

This book is part of the SAS Press program.

A medida que las agencias reguladoras internacionales impulsan el concepto de Calidad por Diseño (QbD), hay un énfasis creciente para optimizar el procesamiento de productos. Este libro utiliza ejemplos prácticos de las industrias farmacéutica y de dispositivos médicos para ilustrar formas fáciles de entender de incorporar elementos QbD utilizando JMP. Calidad Farmacéutica por Diseño Utilizando JMP se abre demostrando la fácil navegación de JMP para visualizar los datos a través de la función de distribución y el constructor de gráficos y luego destaca lo siguiente:
la poderosa naturaleza dinámica de la visualización de datos que permite a los usuarios extraer rápidamente información significativa
herramientas y técnicas diseñadas para el uso de conjuntos de experimentos estructurados y multivariados
ejemplos de análisis complejos únicos en productos sanitarios tales como distribuciones de tamaño de partículas/disolución de drogas, estabilidad de los productos de drogas con el tiempo, y mezcla uniformidad de uniformidad/contenido.

Científicos, ingenieros y técnicos involucrados en los ciclos de vida de productos farmacéuticos y médicos encontrarán este libro invaluable.

Este libro forma parte del programa SAS Press.

title: Competing on Analytics: The New Science of Winning
description: You have more information at hand about your business environment than ever before. But are you using it to “out-think” your rivals? If not, you may be missing out on a potent competitive tool.In Competing on Analytics: The New Science of Winning, Thomas H. Davenport and Jeanne G. Harris argue that the frontier for using data to make decisions has shifted dramatically. Certain high-performing enterprises are now building their competitive strategies around data-driven insights that in turn generate impressive business results. Their secret weapon? Analytics: sophisticated quantitative and statistical analysis and predictive modeling.Exemplars of analytics are using new tools to identify their most profitable customers and offer them the right price, to accelerate product innovation, to optimize supply chains, and to identify the true drivers of financial performance. A wealth of examples—from organizations as diverse as Amazon, Barclay’s, Capital One, Harrah’s, Procter & Gamble, Wachovia, and the Boston Red Sox—illuminate how to leverage the power of analytics.

Harris argumentan que la frontera para utilizar datos para tomar decisiones ha cambiado dramáticamente. Algunas empresas de alto rendimiento están construyendo ahora sus estrategias competitivas en torno a los conocimientos basados en datos que a su vez generan resultados empresariales impresionantes. ¿Su arma secreta? Análisis: sofisticado análisis cuantitativo y estadístico y modelado predictivo. Exemplars of analytics están utilizando nuevas herramientas para identificar a sus clientes más rentables y ofrecerles el precio adecuado, para acelerar la innovación de productos, optimizar las cadenas de suministro, e identificar los verdaderos motores de rendimiento financiero. Una gran cantidad de ejemplos —de organizaciones tan diversas como Amazon, Barclay's, Capital One, Harrah's, Procter & Gamble, Wachovia y el Boston Red Sox— iluminan cómo aprovechar el poder de la analítica.

title: Beyond Artificial Intelligence
description:
This book will present a complete modeling of the human psychic system that allows to generate the thoughts in a strictly organizational approach that mixes a rising and falling approach. The model will present the architecture of the psychic system that can generate sensations and thoughts, showing how one can feel thoughts.

The model developed into an organizational architecture based on massive multiagent systems. The architecture will be fully developed, showing how an artificial system can be endowed with consciousness and intentionally generate thoughts and, especially, feel them. These results are multidisciplinary, combining both psychology and computer science disciplines.

Este libro presentará un modelado completo del sistema psíquico humano que permite generar los pensamientos en un enfoque estrictamente organizativo que mezcla un enfoque creciente y cayendo. El modelo presentará la arquitectura del sistema psíquico que puede generar sensaciones y pensamientos, mostrando cómo uno puede sentir pensamientos.

El modelo se convirtió en una arquitectura organizativa basada en sistemas multiagentes masivos. La arquitectura será completamente desarrollada, mostrando cómo un sistema artificial puede ser dotado de conciencia y generar pensamientos intencionalmente y, especialmente, sentirlos. Estos resultados son multidisciplinares, combinando disciplinas tanto de psicología como de informática.

title: Kibana 7 Quick Start Guide
description:
Dive into the world of Kibana 7 with this hands-on guide that simplifies the process of visualizing and analyzing data using Elasticsearch. From fundamental concepts to advanced tools, this book enables you to create intuitive dashboards and leverage powerful machine learning capabilities effectively. Discover how to transform your data into actionable insights with ease.

What this Book will help me do

Configure Logstash to fetch and process CSV data for visualization.
Master creating and managing index patterns within Kibana for efficient data navigation.
Effectively apply filters to refine data presentations and insights.
Develop and utilize machine learning jobs in Kibana to identify trends and anomalies.
Create, customize, and share impactful visualizations and dashboards to drive data-driven decisions.

Author(s)

None Srivastava is a technical expert in data visualization and Elasticsearch tools, with practical experience implementing and teaching about the Elastic Stack. The author brings a hands-on approach to this book, simplifying complex concepts for ease of understanding. Their expertise ensures that the book serves both as a learning guide and a practical reference.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for developers and IT professionals who are either new to Kibana or looking to deepen their understanding of its visualization capabilities. It is suitable for individuals working with the Elastic Stack or seeking to leverage Kibana for data analysis purposes. Even if you are progressing from a novice to an intermediate level, this guide will provide future-proof skills to optimize your workflow.

title: Basic Statistics for Trainers
description: The field of statistics is broad and complex, but this Infoline will help training professionals use statistics to execute their jobs even better. Why statistics? First, they allow you to make better decisions because data can be analyzed using proven mathematical principles and logic. Second, data are generated each moment across all business functions, and statistics allows the trainer quickly relate to business processes. Third, repetition is important for learner comprehension, and incorporating statistics and measures into training delivery helps learners acquire knowledge better and faster. And finally, the judicious use of statistics in presentations is a powerful way to support your case at higher organizational levels

En primer lugar, le permiten tomar mejores decisiones porque los datos pueden ser analizados usando principios matemáticos comprobados y lógica. En segundo lugar, los datos se generan cada momento a través de todas las funciones de negocio, y las estadísticas permiten al entrenador relacionarse rápidamente con los procesos de negocio. En tercer lugar, la repetición es importante para la comprensión de los alumnos y la incorporación de estadísticas y medidas en la capacitación ayuda a los alumnos a adquirir conocimientos mejor y más rápido. Y por último, el uso prudente de las estadísticas en las presentaciones es una manera poderosa de apoyar su caso a niveles de organización más altos

title: Practical MATLAB Modeling with Simulink: Programming and Simulating Ordinary and Partial Differential Equations
description:
Employ the essential and hands-on tools and functions of MATLAB's ordinary differential equation (ODE) and partial differential equation (PDE) packages, which are explained and demonstrated via interactive examples and case studies. This book contains dozens of simulations and solved problems via m-files/scripts and Simulink models which help you to learn programming and modeling of more difficult, complex problems that involve the use of ODEs and PDEs.
You’ll become efficient with many of the built-in tools and functions of MATLAB/Simulink while solving more complex engineering and scientific computing problems that require and use differential equations. Practical MATLAB Modeling with Simulink explains various practical issues of programming and modelling.
After reading and using this book, you'll be proficient at using MATLAB and applying the source code from the book's examples as templates for your own projects in data science or engineering.  
What You Will Learn
Model complex problems using MATLAB and Simulink
Gain the programming and modeling essentials of MATLAB using ODEs and PDEs
Use numerical methods to solve 1st and 2nd order ODEs
Solve stiff, higher order, coupled, and implicit ODEs
Employ numerical methods to solve 1st and 2nd order linear PDEs
Solve stiff, higher order, coupled, and implicit PDEs
Who This Book Is For
Engineers, programmers, data scientists, and students majoring in engineering, applied/industrial math, data science, and scientific computing.  This book continues where Apress' Beginning MATLAB and Simulink leaves off.

Emplear las herramientas y funciones esenciales y prácticas de los paquetes de ecuación diferencial ordinaria de MATLAB (ODE) y ecuación diferencial parcial (PDE), que se explican y demuestran a través de ejemplos interactivos y estudios de casos. Este libro contiene docenas de simulaciones y problemas resueltos a través de m-files/scripts y modelos Simulink que le ayudan a aprender programación y modelado de problemas más difíciles y complejos que implican el uso de ODE y PDE.
Usted será eficiente con muchas de las herramientas incorporadas y funciones de MATLAB/Simulink, al tiempo que resuelve problemas más complejos de ingeniería y computación científica que requieren y utilizan ecuaciones diferenciales. Práctica MATLAB El modelado con Simulink explica diversas cuestiones prácticas de programación y modelado.
Después de leer y utilizar este libro, usted será competente en el uso de MATLAB y aplicar el código fuente de los ejemplos del libro como plantillas para sus propios proyectos en ciencia de datos o ingeniería.
Qué aprenderás
Problemas complejos modelo utilizando MATLAB y Simulink
Obtenga los elementos esenciales de programación y elaboración de modelos del MATLAB utilizando ODE y PDE
Use métodos numéricos para resolver los ODE de primer y segundo orden
Resuelva los ODE rígidos, superiores, acoplados e implícitos
Métodos numéricos empleados para resolver PDE lineales de primera y segunda orden
Resuelva los PDE rígidos, superiores, unidos e implícitos

Ingenieros, programadores, científicos de datos y estudiantes de ingeniería, matemáticas aplicadas/industriales, ciencias de datos y computación científica. Este libro continúa donde Apress' Beginning MATLAB y Simulink se va.

title: Up Up and Array!: Dynamic Array Formulas for Excel 365 and Beyond
description:
Understand the power of dynamic arrays: a single formula can generate new and vastly more efficient spreadsheet possibilities. This book introduces spreadsheet users to dynamic array functions in Microsoft Excel 365, defines and details the distinctive ways in which they work, and shows how they can be applied to a wide swath of data-analytic tasks.

While array formulas and functions have long held a place in the spreadsheet toolbox (although, for many of us, shunted to an obscure corner), the dynamic array engine offers a more user-friendly and intelligible set of means for manipulating spreadsheet data in the array mode. The single-formula, multi-cell capability of dynamic arrays has been extended to nearly all existing spreadsheet functions, offering a new, default way of working. As a result, many tasks can now be executed with dynamic arrays without having to resort to the new functions at all.

After defining arrays and dynamic array formulas, this book helps you examine the dynamic array property of lifting and how it impacts the formulas, including those written with existing functions. Plenty of illustrations and formulas along the way help you get comfortable using them. From there, you will learn Excel 365’s new dynamic functions, including the 14 currently in rollout, each accompanied by instructive examples. In many cases, the examples demonstrate how the new functions can work with long-available functions, such as MID, IF, COUNTIF, etc., which now also boast dynamic array functionality.

 

What You Will Learn

Unlock the dynamic array potential in Microsoft Excel
Apply dynamic array functions and confidently direct them to real-world spreadsheet tasks
Know the distinctive ways in which arrays work and can be applied to numerous data-analytic tasks

Who This Book Is For

Users of Excel 365 and beyond who are comfortable with, but not necessarily expert in, formula writing, as well as those who are unaware of or not fluent with dynamic arrays. It is also valuable to data journalists and other professionals in need of spreadsheet skills who may unaware of dynamic arrays, and the time they could save by applying them to their work.
translatedDescription:
Comprender el poder de los arrays dinámicos: una sola fórmula puede generar nuevas y mucho más eficientes posibilidades de hoja de cálculo. Este libro introduce a los usuarios de hojas de cálculo a funciones de matriz dinámicas en Microsoft Excel 365, define y detalla las formas distintivas en las que trabajan, y muestra cómo se pueden aplicar a una amplia gama de tareas analíticas de datos.

Mientras que las fórmulas y funciones de array han mantenido durante mucho tiempo un lugar en la caja de herramientas de hoja de cálculo (aunque, para muchos de nosotros, removidos a una esquina oscura), el motor de matriz dinámica ofrece un conjunto de medios más fácil e inteligible para manipular los datos de hoja de cálculo en el modo array. La capacidad de multicelular de arrays dinámicos se ha extendido a casi todas las funciones de hoja de cálculo existentes, ofreciendo una nueva forma de trabajo predeterminada. Como resultado, muchas tareas ahora se pueden ejecutar con arrays dinámicos sin tener que recurrir a las nuevas funciones en absoluto.

Después de definir arrays y fórmulas de matriz dinámicas, este libro le ayuda a examinar la propiedad de matriz dinámica de elevación y cómo impacta las fórmulas, incluyendo las escritas con funciones existentes. Muchas ilustraciones y fórmulas a lo largo del camino le ayudan a sentirse cómodo utilizandolas. Desde allí aprenderás las nuevas funciones dinámicas de Excel 365, incluyendo las 14 actualmente en marcha, cada una acompañada de ejemplos instructivos. En muchos casos, los ejemplos demuestran cómo las nuevas funciones pueden funcionar con funciones siempre disponibles, como MID, IF, COUNTIF, etc., que ahora también cuentan con funcionalidad de matriz dinámica.



Qué aprenderás

Desbloquear el potencial de matriz dinámica en Microsoft Excel
Aplicar funciones de matriz dinámicas y dirigirlas con confianza a tareas de hoja de cálculo del mundo real
Conocer las formas distintivas en que funcionan los arrays y se pueden aplicar a numerosas tareas analíticas de datos

Quién es este libro

Usuarios de Excel 365 y más allá de quienes se sienten cómodos, pero no necesariamente expertos en la escritura de fórmulas, así como aquellos que no conocen o no fluen con arrays dinámicos. También es valioso para los periodistas de datos y otros profesionales que necesitan habilidades de hoja de cálculo que puedan desconocer los arrays dinámicos, y el tiempo que podrían ahorrar al aplicarlos a su trabajo.

title: Access Cookbook, 2nd Edition
description: Not a reference book, and not a tutorial either, the new second edition of the highly regarded Access Cookbook is an uncommonly useful collection of solutions to problems that Access users and developers are likely to face as they attempt to build increasingly complex applications.Although using any single "recipe" in the book will more than pay back the cost of the book in terms of both hours saved and frustration thwarted, Access Cookbook, Second Edition is much more than a handy assortment of cut-and-paste code.Each of the "recipes" examine a particular problem--problems that commonly occur when you push the upper limits of Access, or ones that are likely to trip up a developer attempting to design a more elegant Access application--even some things you never knew Access could do. The authors then, in a clear, accessible, step-by-step style, present the problems' solution. Following each "recipe" are insights on how Access works, potential pitfalls, interesting programming techniques that are used in the solution, and how and why the solution works, so you can adapt the problem-solving techniques to other similar situations.Fully updated for Access 2003, Access Cookbook, Second Edition is also one of the first books to thoroughly explore new support for .NET managed code and XML. All of the practical, real-world examples have been tested for compatibility with Access 2003, Windows XP, and Windows Server 2003. This updated new edition also covers Access and SharePoint, Access and SmartTags, Access and .NET; and Access and XML.Access power users and programmers at all levels, from the relatively inexperienced to the most sophisticated, will rely on the Access Cookbook for quick solutions to gnarly problems. With a dog-eared copy of Access Cookbook at your side, you can spend your time and energy where it matters most: working on the interesting facets of your Access application, not just the time-consuming ones.

description: Demystify AI and discover how it can improve your productivity and innovation at work with Taming the Machine, an accessible and comprehensive insight into the practical mechanisms, ethics and potential of AI.

title: Survival Analysis Using SAS®: A Practical Guide
description: Biomedical and social science researchers who want to analyze survival data with SAS will find just what they need with this easy-to-read and comprehensive guide. Written for the reader with a modest statistical background and minimal knowledge of SAS software, this book teaches many aspects of data input and manipulation. Numerous examples of SAS code and output make this an eminently practical resource, ensuring that even the uninitiated becomes a sophisticated user of survival analysis. The main topics presented include censoring, survival curves, Kaplan-Meier estimation, accelerated failure time models, Cox regression models, and discrete-time analysis. Also included are topics not usually covered, such as time-dependent covariates, competing risks, and repeated events.
translatedDescription: Investigadores biomédicos y de ciencias sociales que quieren analizar datos de supervivencia con SAS encontrarán lo que necesitan con esta guía fácil de leer y completa. Escrito para el lector con un modesto fondo estadístico y un conocimiento mínimo del software SAS, este libro enseña muchos aspectos de la entrada y manipulación de datos. Numerosos ejemplos de código y salida SAS hacen de este un recurso eminentemente práctico, asegurando que incluso los no iniciados se conviertan en un usuario sofisticado de análisis de supervivencia. Los principales temas presentados incluyen censura, curvas de supervivencia, estimación de Kaplan-Meier, modelos de tiempo de falla acelerado, modelos de regresión de Cox y análisis de tiempo discreto. También se incluyen temas no usualmente cubiertos, como covariados dependientes del tiempo, riesgos de competencia y eventos repetidos.

title: Data Visualization with Python and JavaScript
description:
Learn how to turn raw data into rich, interactive web visualizations with the powerful combination of Python and JavaScript. With this hands-on guide, author Kyran Dale teaches you how build a basic dataviz toolchain with best-of-breed Python and JavaScript libraries—including Scrapy, Matplotlib, Pandas, Flask, and D3—for crafting engaging, browser-based visualizations.

As a working example, throughout the book Dale walks you through transforming Wikipedia’s table-based list of Nobel Prize winners into an interactive visualization. You’ll examine steps along the entire toolchain, from scraping, cleaning, exploring, and delivering data to building the visualization with JavaScript’s D3 library. If you’re ready to create your own web-based data visualizations—and know either Python or JavaScript— this is the book for you.

Learn how to manipulate data with Python
Understand the commonalities between Python and JavaScript
Extract information from websites by using Python’s web-scraping tools, BeautifulSoup and Scrapy
Clean and explore data with Python’s Pandas, Matplotlib, and Numpy libraries
Serve data and create RESTful web APIs with Python’s Flask framework
Create engaging, interactive web visualizations with JavaScript’s D3 library

Aprende a convertir los datos crudos en ricas visualizaciones interactivas web con la poderosa combinación de Python y JavaScript. Con esta guía práctica, el autor Kyran Dale te enseña cómo construir una cadena de herramientas de dataviz básica con las mejores bibliotecas Python y JavaScript de raza, Matplotlib, Pandas, Flask y D3 para crear visualizaciones atractivas basadas en el navegador.

Como ejemplo de trabajo, a lo largo del libro Dale te lleva transformando la lista de ganadores del Premio Nobel de Wikipedia en una visualización interactiva. Examinará pasos a lo largo de toda la cadena de herramientas, desde la chatarra, limpieza, exploración y entrega de datos para construir la visualización con la biblioteca D3 de JavaScript. Si usted está listo para crear sus propias visualizaciones de datos basadas en la web —y conoce Python o JavaScript— este es el libro para usted.

Servir datos y crear APIs web RESTful con el marco de Flask de Python
Crear visualizaciones web atractivas e interactivas con la biblioteca D3 de JavaScript

title: Statistics for Health Care Professionals: Working With Excel, 2nd Edition
description: Statistics for Health Care Professionals: Working with Excel (second edition) is written in a clear, easily followed style keyed to the powerful statistical tool, Microsoft Excel 2007. It introduces the use of statistics applicable to health administration, health policy, public health, health information management, and other professions, emphasizing the logic of probability and statistical analysis in all areas. Coverage includes data acquisition, data display, basics of probability, data distributions, confidence limits and hypothesis testing, statistical tests for categorical data, tests for related and unrelated data, analysis of variance, simple linear regression, multiple regression, and analysis with a dichotomous categorical dependent variable. A glossary and section-by-section review questions round out this uniquely comprehensive and accessible text.

Presenta el uso de estadísticas aplicables a la administración de salud, la política de salud, la salud pública, la gestión de la información sanitaria y otras profesiones, haciendo hincapié en la lógica de probabilidad y análisis estadístico en todas las esferas. La cobertura incluye adquisición de datos, visualización de datos, fundamentos de probabilidad, distribuciones de datos, límites de confianza y pruebas de hipótesis, pruebas estadísticas para datos categóricos, pruebas para datos relacionados y no relacionados, análisis de varianza, regresión lineal simple, regresión múltiple y análisis con una variable dependiente categórica dicotomosa. title: Data Importing Techniques
description: This series will equip learners with various techniques for efficient data manipulation, crucial for optimizing analysis workflows. It addresses common data challenges and teaches skills in importing, cleaning and transforming, and presenting data, enhancing analytical precision and speed.

Aborda los desafíos de datos comunes y enseña habilidades en la importación, limpieza y transformación, y presentando datos, mejorando la precisión analítica y la velocidad.

title: The Great Power Shift: How Intelligent Choice Architectures Rewrite Decision Rights
description: This is the second article of a multipart series in which MIT Sloan Management Review researchers, in collaboration with Tata Consultancy Services, explore how artificial intelligence can be used to present leaders and workers with better options in decision-making. Here, they explore three structural shifts stemming from the adoption of agentic AI that will require leaders to proactively address decision rights allocations, power dynamics, and decision-making practices.
translatedDescription: Este es el segundo artículo de una serie multipart en la que investigadores de MIT Sloan Management Review, en colaboración con Tata Consultancy Services, exploran cómo se puede utilizar la inteligencia artificial para presentar líderes y trabajadores con mejores opciones en la toma de decisiones. En este sentido, se exploran tres cambios estructurales derivados de la adopción de la IA, que requerirá que los líderes aborden proactivamente las asignaciones de derechos de decisión, la dinámica de poder y las prácticas de adopción de decisiones.

title: Commodity Modeling and Pricing: Methods for Analyzing Resource Market Behavior
description: Commodity Modeling and Pricing provides extensions and applications of state-of-the-art methods for analyzing resource commodity behavior. Drawing from the seminal work of Professor Walter Labys on the development of econometric methods for forecasting commodity prices, this collection of essays features expert contributors ranging from practitioners in private industry, public sector, and nongovernmental organizations to scholars in higher education-all of whom were Labys's former students or collaborators. Filled with in-depth insights and expert advice, Commodity Modeling and Pricing contains the information you need to excel in this demanding environment.
translatedDescription: El modelado y los precios de los productos básicos proporciona extensiones y aplicaciones de métodos de última generación para analizar el comportamiento de los productos básicos. Basándose en el trabajo seminal del profesor Walter Labys sobre el desarrollo de métodos econométricos para la previsión de precios de los productos básicos, esta colección de ensayos cuenta con colaboradores expertos que van desde profesionales de la industria privada, el sector público y organizaciones no gubernamentales a académicos de educación superior, todos ellos antiguos estudiantes o colaboradores de Labys. Repleto de información detallada y asesoramiento experto, la modelación de productos básicos y precios contiene la información que necesita para sobresalir en este entorno exigente.

title: Oracle Database Transactions and Locking Revealed
description:
Oracle Database Transactions and Locking Revealed provides much-needed information for building scalable, high-concurrency applications and deploy them against the Oracle Database. Read this short, 150-page book that is adapted from Expert Oracle Database Architecture to gain a solid and accurate understanding of how locking and concurrency are dealt with by Oracle Database. Also learn how the Oracle Database architecture accommodates user transactions, and how you can write code to mesh with how Oracle Database is designed to operate.

Good transaction design is an important facet of highly-concurrent applications that are run by hundreds, even thousands of users who are all executing transactions at the same time. Transaction design in turn relies upon a good understanding of how the underlying database platform manages of the locking of resources so as to prevent access conflicts and data loss that might otherwise result from concurrent access to data in the database.

Oracle Database Transactions and Locking Revealed covers in detail the various lock types, and also different locking schemes such as pessimistic and optimistic locking. Then you'll learn about transaction isolation and multiversion concurrency, and how the various lock types support Oracle Databases transactional features. You'll learn some good tips for transaction design, as well as some bad practices and habits to avoid. Coverage is also given to redo and undo, and their role in concurrency. This is an important book that anyone developing highly-concurrent applications will want to have handy on their shelf.
translatedDescription:
Oracle Database Transactions y Locking Revealed proporciona información muy necesaria para construir aplicaciones escalables y de alto nivel y desplegarlas contra la Base de Datos de Oracle. Lea este breve libro de 150 páginas que se adapta de Expert Oracle Database Architecture para obtener una comprensión sólida y precisa de cómo el bloqueo y la concurrencia son tratados por Oracle Database. También aprenda cómo la arquitectura de la base de datos de Oracle acoge las transacciones de usuario, y cómo puede escribir código para malla con cómo Oracle Database está diseñado para operar.

El buen diseño de transacción es una faceta importante de aplicaciones altamente concurrentes que son gestionadas por cientos, incluso miles de usuarios que están ejecutando transacciones al mismo tiempo. El diseño de las transacciones se basa a su vez en una buena comprensión de la forma en que la plataforma de base de datos subyacente gestiona el bloqueo de recursos para evitar conflictos de acceso y la pérdida de datos que podrían derivar de otro modo del acceso simultáneo a los datos en la base de datos.

Oracle Base de datos Transacciones y bloqueo Revealed cubre en detalle los diversos tipos de bloqueo, y también diferentes esquemas de bloqueo como el bloqueo pesimista y optimista. Luego aprenderá sobre el aislamiento de transacción y la concurrencia de multiversión, y cómo los diversos tipos de bloqueo soportan las características transaccionales de Oracle Databases. Usted aprenderá algunos buenos consejos para el diseño de transacciones, así como algunas malas prácticas y hábitos para evitar. También se da cobertura para rehacer y deshacer, y su papel en la concurrencia. Este es un libro importante que cualquier persona que desarrolle aplicaciones altamente concurrentes querrá tener útil en su estante.

title: MongoDB Basics
description: Need a quick and easy to understand introduction to MongoDB and NoSQL databases? MongoDB Basics, from The Definitive Guide to MongoDB, 2E, shows you how a document-oriented database system differs from a relational database, and how to install and get started using it. You'll also learn MongoDB design basics, including geospatial indexing, how to navigate, view, and query your database, and how to use GridFS with a bit of Python.
