Swarm Intelligence y computación bio-inspirada se han vuelto cada vez más populares en las últimas dos décadas. Algoritmos bio-inspirados como algoritmos de colonia de hormigas, algoritmos de murciélago, algoritmos de abeja, algoritmos de luciérnagas, búsqueda de cuco y optimización de partículas se han aplicado en casi todas las áreas de ciencia e ingeniería con un aumento dramático del número de publicaciones relevantes. Este libro repasa los últimos desarrollos en inteligencia enjambre y computación bio-inspirada tanto de la teoría como de la aplicación, proporcionando un recurso completo que analiza y discute las últimas y futuras tendencias en las direcciones de investigación. Puede ayudar a los nuevos investigadores a realizar investigaciones oportunas e inspirar a los lectores a desarrollar nuevos algoritmos. Con su impresionante amplitud y profundidad, este libro será útil para estudiantes de pregrado avanzados, estudiantes de doctorado y profesores en ciencias informáticas, ingeniería y ciencia, así como investigadores e ingenieros.

Se centra en la introducción y análisis de algoritmos clave
Incluye estudios de casos para aplicaciones reales
Contiene un equilibrio de teoría y aplicaciones, por lo que los lectores que están interesados en algoritmo o aplicaciones se beneficiarán de este libro oportuno.

title: XPath: Navigating XML with XPath 1.0 and 2.0 Kick Start
description:
XPath is to XML as SQL is to databases: XML applications need XPath to locate specific data within an XML document for further processing with other XML applications such as XSLT, XQuery, XPointer, XLink and DOM level 3. With XPath, these applications offer developers a full toolkit for transforming, linking, and searching XML data. Developers need to understand XPath to fully exploit XML in their applications, and they have few resources beyond the W3C specification. XPath Kick Start will examine every aspect of XPath in detail, including its influence on and use with these other XML standards.

With each technique illustrated with real-world examples, the book starts with coverage of the essentials of XPath, including nodes, expressions, functions and operators. The second half of the book details XPath in practice - from manipulating XML data to transforming, linking and querying XML documents.
translatedDescription:
XPath es a XML como SQL es a bases de datos: las aplicaciones XML necesitan XPath para localizar datos específicos dentro de un documento XML para su posterior procesamiento con otras aplicaciones XML como XSLT, XQuery, XPointer, XLink y DOM Level 3. Con XPath, estas aplicaciones ofrecen a los desarrolladores un conjunto completo de herramientas para transformar, vincular y buscar datos XML. Los desarrolladores necesitan entender XPath para explotar completamente XML en sus aplicaciones, y tienen pocos recursos más allá de la especificación W3C. XPath Kick Start examinará cada aspecto de XPath en detalle, incluyendo su influencia y uso con estos otros estándares XML.

Con cada técnica ilustrada con ejemplos reales, el libro comienza con la cobertura de lo esencial de XPath, incluyendo nodos, expresiones, funciones y operadores. La segunda mitad del libro detalla XPath en la práctica, desde la manipulación de datos XML hasta la transformación, vinculación y consulta de documentos XML.

title: Swarm Intelligence and Evolutionary Computation

Dive into topics such as database design, advanced query handling, and security configuration, and gain hands-on experience through practical examples and insights.

What this Book will help me do

Learn to configure and install MongoDB 4.x for development and administration.
Understand the principles of NoSQL schema design for optimal performance.
Perform complex queries and operations to manage your MongoDB databases.
Secure your MongoDB setup with role-based access control and encryption techniques.
Monitor and optimize database performance for production environments.

None Bierer, the author of 'Learn MongoDB 4.x,' is a seasoned database expert with extensive experience in NoSQL technologies. With a focus on practicality and clear explanations, None brings deep insights into MongoDB's development and administration.

title: Beginning Access™ 2007 VBA
description: This book provides you with the tools and techniques you'll need in order to build more sophisticated solutions. You'll then progress to advanced VBA concepts such as working with external DLLs and using automation to control external programs. title: Implementing CIFS: The Common Internet File System
description:
"The book that Microsoft should have written, but didn't." —Jeremy Allison, Samba Team

"Your detailed explanations are clear and backed-up with source code—and the numerous bits of humor make a dry subject very enjoyable to read." —J.D. Lindemann, network engineer, Adaptec, Inc.

The first developer's guide to Microsoft®'s Internet/Intranet file sharing standard

For years, developers and administrators have struggled to understand CIFS, Microsoft's poorly documented standard for Internet file sharing. Finally, there is an authoritative, cross-platform guide to CIFS capabilities and behavior. Implementing CIFS not only delivers the priceless knowledge of a Samba Team member dedicated to investigating the inner workings of CIFS, it also identifies and describes crucial specifications and supporting documents.

Provides essential information for designing and debugging large Windows® and/or Samba networks

Offers clear, in-depth introductions to Server Message Block (SMB), NetBIOS over TCP/IP (NBT), browser services, and authentication

Drills down into the internals of CIFS, exposing its behavior on the wire and at the desktop—and its strange quirks

Presents illustrative code examples throughout

Reflects years of work reviewing obscure documentation, packet traces, and sourcecode

Includes the SNIA CIFS Technical Reference

Implementing CIFS will be indispensable to every developer who wants to provide CIFS compatibility—and every administrator or security specialist who needs an in-depth understanding of how it really works.

"El libro que Microsoft debería haber escrito, pero no lo hizo." —Jeremy Allison, Samba Team

Guía del primer desarrollador del estándar de compartir archivos de Microsoft® Internet/Intranet

Durante años, los desarrolladores y administradores han luchado por entender CIFS, el estándar mal documentado de Microsoft para compartir archivos de Internet. Por último, hay una guía autorizada y multiplataforma para las capacidades y el comportamiento del CIFS. Implementing CIFS no sólo ofrece el conocimiento invaluable de un miembro del Equipo Samba dedicado a investigar los trabajos internos de CIFS, sino que también identifica y describe especificaciones cruciales y documentos de apoyo.

Proporciona información esencial para diseñar y depurar grandes redes Windows® y/o Samba

Ofrece presentaciones claras y detalladas al Server Message Block (SMB), NetBIOS sobre TCP/IP (NBT), servicios del navegador y autenticación

Perfora hacia abajo en los internos del CIFS, exponiendo su comportamiento en el alambre y en el escritorio - y sus extraños quirks

Presenta ejemplos ilustrativos de código en todas partes

Refleja años de trabajo revisando documentación oscura, trazas de paquetes y código fuente

Incluye la referencia técnica SNIA CIFS

Implementar CIFS será indispensable para cada desarrollador que desee proporcionar compatibilidad con CIFS, y para cada administrador o especialista en seguridad que necesite una comprensión profunda de cómo funciona realmente.

title: Hands-On Python Natural Language Processing
description:
Dive into the world of Natural Language Processing (NLP) with "Hands-On Python Natural Language Processing." From mastering text classification to crafting chatbots, you'll gain hands-on experience in implementing NLP methods and utilizing cutting-edge algorithms.

What this Book will help me do

Understand the fundamental principles of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and its significance in modern applications.
Utilize Python libraries to perform NLP tasks, process text data, and build linguistic models.
Develop proficiency in applying machine learning and deep learning techniques for NLP.
Design and implement applications that perform tasks like sentiment analysis, text classification, and language translation.
Explore advanced NLP architectures and methodologies to enhance linguistic model performance.

The authors, None Kedia and None Rasu, are experienced practitioners in the field of NLP and have extensive expertise in Python and applied machine learning. Some familiarity with Python and mathematics will ensure you grasp the concepts with ease. It's also an essential resource for professionals aiming to incorporate NLP in their real-world projects.

title: Bioinformatics with Python Cookbook - Second Edition
description:
"Bioinformatics with Python Cookbook" offers a detailed exploration into the modern approaches to computational biology using the Python programming language. Through hands-on recipes, you will master the practical applications of bioinformatics, enabling you to analyze vast biological data effectively using Python libraries and tools.

What this Book will help me do

Master processing and analyzing genomic datasets in Python to enable accurate bioinformatics discoveries.
Understand and apply next-generation sequencing techniques for advanced biological research.
Learn to utilize machine learning approaches such as PCA and decision trees for insightful data analysis in biology.
Gain proficiency in using high-performance computing frameworks like Dask and Spark for scalable bioinformatics workflows.
Develop capabilities to visually represent biological data interactions and insights for presentation and analysis.

Author(s)

Tiago Antao is a computational scientist specializing in bioinformatics with extensive experience in Python programming applied to biological sciences. He has worked on numerous bioinformatics projects and has a special interest in using Python to bridge biology and data science. Tiago's approachable writing style ensures that both newcomers and experts benefit from his insights.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for bioinformatics professionals, researchers, and data scientists who are eager to harness the power of Python programming for their biological data analysis needs. If you are familiar with Python and are looking to tackle intermediate to advanced bioinformatics challenges using practical recipes, this book is ideal for you. It is suitable for those seeking to expand their knowledge in computational biology and data visualization techniques. Whether you are working on next-generation sequencing or population genetics, this resource will guide you effectively.

title: Best Practices for Implementing a Lakehouse
description: This video shortcuts collection reviews the fundamentals of the lakehouse. title: IBM Spectrum Protect Plus Practical Guidance for Deployment, Configuration, and Usage
description:
IBM® Spectrum Protect Plus is a data protection solution that provides near-instant recovery, replication, retention management, and reuse for virtual machines, databases, and applications backups in hybrid multicloud environments.

IBM Knowledge Center for IBM Spectrum® Protect Plus provides extensive documentation for installation, deployment, and usage. In addition, build and size an IBM Spectrum Protect Plus solution.

The goal of this IBM Redpaper® publication is to summarize and complement the available information by providing useful hints and tips that are based on the authors' practical experience in installing and supporting IBM Spectrum Protect Plus in customer environments. Over time, our aim is to compile a set of best practices that cover all aspects of the product, from planning and installation to tuning, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

IBM Knowledge Center for IBM Spectrum® Protect Plus proporciona una amplia documentación para la instalación, implementación y uso. Además, construir y tamaño una solución IBM Spectrum Protect Plus.

Con el tiempo, nuestro objetivo es compilar un conjunto de mejores prácticas que cubren todos los aspectos del producto, desde la planificación e instalación hasta la sintonización, mantenimiento y solución de problemas.

title: Identification and Management of Distributed Data
description: This book guides readers through the discovery of distributed data management on the web, in next generation networks (NGNs), and in new content-centric networking paradigms. The authors provide a novel perspective with particular emphasis on naming and identification issues, which are concepts that must be grasped in order to build and deploy more efficient data interoperability paradigms in future networks. The book covers special insights, ongoing research projects, and standardization initiatives.

Los autores proporcionan una perspectiva novedosa con especial énfasis en temas de nombramiento e identificación, que son conceptos que deben comprenderse para construir e implementar paradigmas de interoperabilidad de datos más eficientes en futuras redes. El libro abarca ideas especiales, proyectos de investigación en curso e iniciativas de estandarización.

title: Automotive Ergonomics
description: This book presents the latest developments and addresses its implications for the design of modern and future vehicles. It covers new areas such as human-machine interaction as well as power train and alternative fuels, which create new challenges as well as opportunities for the automotive industry. A special chapter is devoted to Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). The text also explains vibration in vehicles, noise perception, and digital human modeling, among other topics, in addition to discussions of best practices and emerging developments.

El texto también explica vibraciones en vehículos, percepción de ruido y modelado humano digital, entre otros temas, además de discusiones sobre mejores prácticas y desarrollos emergentes.

title: Introduction to Biostatistics with JMP
description:
Explore biostatistics using JMP in this refreshing introduction

Presented in an easy-to-understand way, Introduction to Biostatistics with JMP introduces undergraduate students in the biological sciences to the most commonly used (and misused) statistical methods that they will need to analyze their experimental data using JMP. It covers many of the basic topics in statistics using biological examples for exercises so that the student biologists can see the relevance to future work in the problems addressed.

The book starts by teaching students how to become confident in executing the right analysis by thinking like a statistician then moves into the application of specific tests. Using the powerful capabilities of JMP, the book addresses problems requiring analysis by chi-square tests, t tests, ANOVA analysis, various regression models, DOE, and survival analysis. Topics of particular interest to the biological or health science field include odds ratios, relative risk,

title: Reliability Prediction and Testing Textbook
description:
This textbook reviews the methodologies of reliability prediction as currently used in industries such as electronics, automotive, aircraft, aerospace, off-highway, farm machinery, and others. It then discusses why these are not successful; and, presents methods developed by the authors for obtaining accurate information for successful prediction. The approach is founded on approaches that accurately duplicate the real world use of the product. Their approach is based on two fundamental components needed for successful reliability prediction; first, the methodology necessary; and, second, use of accelerated reliability and durability testing as a source of the necessary data.

Applicable to all areas of engineering, this textbook details the newest techniques and tools to achieve successful reliabilityprediction and testing. It demonstrates practical examples of the implementation of the approaches described. This book is a tool for engineers, managers, researchers, in industry, teachers, and students. The reader will learn the importance of the interactions of the influencing factors and the interconnections of safety and human factors in product prediction and testing.
translatedDescription:
En este libro de texto se examinan las metodologías de predicción de fiabilidad que se utilizan actualmente en industrias como electrónicas, automotrices, aeronaves, aeroespaciales, fuera de la autopista, maquinaria agrícola y otros. A continuación se analiza por qué no tienen éxito; y, presenta métodos elaborados por los autores para obtener información precisa para la predicción exitosa. El enfoque se basa en enfoques que duplican con precisión el uso mundial real del producto. Su enfoque se basa en dos componentes fundamentales necesarios para una predicción de fiabilidad exitosa; primero, la metodología necesaria; y segundo, el uso de pruebas de fiabilidad y durabilidad aceleradas como fuente de los datos necesarios.

Aplicable a todas las áreas de ingeniería, este libro de texto detalla las técnicas e instrumentos más recientes para lograr una confiabilidad y pruebas exitosas. Muestra ejemplos prácticos de la aplicación de los enfoques descritos. Este libro es una herramienta para ingenieros, gerentes, investigadores, en la industria, maestros y estudiantes. El lector aprenderá la importancia de las interacciones de los factores de influencia y las interconexiones de seguridad y factores humanos en la predicción y prueba de productos.

title: Practical Applications of Bayesian Reliability
description:
Demonstrates how to solve reliability problems using practical applications of Bayesian models

This self-contained reference provides fundamental knowledge of Bayesian reliability and utilizes numerous examples to show how Bayesian models can solve real life reliability problems. It teaches engineers and scientists exactly what Bayesian analysis is, what its benefits are, and how they can apply the methods to solve their own problems. To help readers get started quickly, the book presents many Bayesian models that use JAGS and which require fewer than 10 lines of command. It also offers a number of short R scripts consisting of simple functions to help them become familiar with R coding.

Practical Applications of Bayesian Reliability starts by introducing basic concepts of reliability engineering, including random variables, discrete and continuous probability distributions, hazard function, and censored data. Basic concepts of Bayesian statistics, models, reasons, and theory are presented in the following chapter. Coverage of Bayesian computation, Metropolis-Hastings algorithm, and Gibbs Sampling comes next. The book then goes on to teach the concepts of design capability and design for reliability; introduce Bayesian models for estimating system reliability; discuss Bayesian Hierarchical Models and their applications; present linear and logistic regression models in Bayesian Perspective; and more. 

Provides a step-by-step approach for developing advanced reliability models to solve complex problems, and does not require in-depth understanding of statistical methodology
Educates managers on the potential of Bayesian reliability models and associated impact
Introduces commonly used predictive reliability models and advanced Bayesian models based on real life applications
Includes practical guidelines to construct Bayesian reliability models along with computer codes for all of the case studies
JAGS and R codes are provided on an accompanying website to enable practitioners to easily copy them and tailor them to their own applications 

Practical Applications of Bayesian Reliability is a helpful book for industry practitioners such as reliability engineers, mechanical engineers, electrical engineers, product engineers, system engineers, and materials scientists whose work includes predicting design or product performance.
translatedDescription:
Demuestra cómo resolver problemas de fiabilidad utilizando aplicaciones prácticas de modelos Bayesian

Esta referencia autocontenida proporciona un conocimiento fundamental de la confiabilidad Bayesiana y utiliza numerosos ejemplos para mostrar cómo los modelos Bayesian pueden resolver problemas de fiabilidad de la vida real. Enseña a ingenieros y científicos exactamente lo que es el análisis Bayesiano, cuáles son sus beneficios, y cómo pueden aplicar los métodos para resolver sus propios problemas. Para ayudar a los lectores a comenzar rápidamente, el libro presenta muchos modelos Bayesian que utilizan JAGS y que requieren menos de 10 líneas de comando. También ofrece una serie de scripts R cortos que consisten en funciones simples para ayudarles a familiarizarse con la codificación R.

Las aplicaciones prácticas de la fiabilidad bayesiana comienzan introduciendo conceptos básicos de ingeniería de confiabilidad, incluyendo variables aleatorias, distribuciones discretas y continuas de probabilidad, función de peligro y datos censurados. En el capítulo siguiente se presentan conceptos básicos de estadísticas, modelos, razones y teoría bayesianas. La cobertura de la computación Bayesiana, el algoritmo de Metropolis-Hastings, y Gibbs Sampling viene después. El libro sigue enseñando los conceptos de capacidad de diseño y diseño para la confiabilidad; introducir modelos Bayesian para estimar la fiabilidad del sistema; discutir los modelos jerárquicos Bayesian y sus aplicaciones; presentar modelos de regresión lineal y logística en Bayesian Perspective; y más.

Proporciona un enfoque paso a paso para elaborar modelos avanzados de fiabilidad para resolver problemas complejos, y no requiere una comprensión profunda de la metodología estadística
Educa a los gerentes sobre el potencial de los modelos de confiabilidad Bayesian e impacto asociado
Presenta modelos de confiabilidad predictiva de uso común y modelos Bayesian avanzados basados en aplicaciones de la vida real

title: Knowledge Management and Innovation
description:
This book explores the relationships between knowledge management (KM) processes and innovation management.

The geographical extension of markets and intensification of competition have led firms to experiment with novel approaches to innovation. New organizational forms emerged in which firms collaborate with various stakeholders to create, absorb, integrate and protect knowledge. This book explores how knowledge management processes evolve with firms’ implementation of interactive, collaborative and open innovation models and it identifies the various knowledge types and processes involved throughout the different phases of the innovation process.

The authors provide operational typologies for understanding innovative firms’ capabilities and knowledge management practices and also discuss the main properties of four models of interactive innovation, namely open innovation, user-centric innovation, community-based innovation and crowdsourcing.
translatedDescription:
Este libro explora las relaciones entre los procesos de gestión de conocimientos y la gestión de la innovación.

La extensión geográfica de los mercados y la intensificación de la competencia han llevado a las empresas a experimentar nuevos enfoques de la innovación. Nuevas formas de organización surgieron en las que las empresas colaboran con diversos interesados para crear, absorber, integrar y proteger los conocimientos. Este libro explora cómo evolucionan los procesos de gestión del conocimiento con la implementación de modelos de innovación interactivos, colaborativos y abiertos de las empresas y identifica los diversos tipos de conocimientos y procesos involucrados en las diferentes fases del proceso de innovación.

Los autores proporcionan tipologías operativas para entender las capacidades de las empresas innovadoras y las prácticas de gestión del conocimiento y también analizan las principales propiedades de cuatro modelos de innovación interactiva, a saber, innovación abierta, innovación centrada en el usuario, innovación basada en la comunidad y crowdsourcing.

title: Essentials of Mathematical Statistics
description:
Part of the Jones and Bartlett Learning International Series in Mathematics

Written for the one-term introductory probability and statistics course for mid- to upper-level math and science majors, Essentials of Mathematical Statistics combines the topics generally found in main-stream elementary statistics books with the essentials of the underlying theory. The book begins with an axiomatic treatment of probability followed by chapters on discrete and continuous random variables and their associated distributions. It then introduces basic statistical concepts including summarizing data and interval parameter estimation, stressing the connection between probability and statistics. Final chapters introduce hypothesis testing, regression, and non-parametric techniques. All chapters provide a balance between conceptual understanding and theoretical understanding of the topics at hand.

Key Features of Essentials of Mathematical Statistics:

- End-of-section exercises range from computational to conceptual to theoretical.- Many sections include a sub-section titled “Software Calculations” which gives detailed descriptions of how to perform the calculations discussed in the section using the software Minitab, R, Excel, and the TI-83/84 calculators.- Provides a clear balance between conceptual understanding and theoretical understanding- Exercises throughout vary in level of difficulty and scope.
translatedDescription:
Parte de la serie internacional de aprendizaje de Jones y Bartlett en matemáticas

Escrito para el curso de probabilidad introductoria de un solo término y estadísticas para los principales de matemáticas y ciencias de nivel medio a alto, Essentials of Mathematical Statistics combina los temas generalmente encontrados en los libros de estadística primaria de corriente principal con los elementos esenciales de la teoría subyacente. El libro comienza con un tratamiento axiomático de probabilidad seguido por capítulos sobre variables discretas y continuas aleatorias y sus distribuciones asociadas. Luego introduce conceptos estadísticos básicos, incluyendo la estimación de datos y parámetros de intervalo, destacando la conexión entre probabilidad y estadística. Los capítulos finales introducen pruebas de hipótesis, regresión y técnicas no paramétricas. Todos los capítulos proporcionan un equilibrio entre la comprensión conceptual y la comprensión teórica de los temas a la mano.

- Los ejercicios de fin de sección varían de computacional a conceptual a teórico.- Muchas secciones incluyen una subsección titulada “Cálculos de software” que da descripciones detalladas de cómo realizar los cálculos discutidos en la sección utilizando el software Minitab, R, Excel y las calculadoras TI-83/84.- Proporciona un claro equilibrio entre el entendimiento conceptual y el entendimiento teórico- Los ejercicios varían en el nivel de dificultad y alcance.

title: Entity Resolution and Information Quality
description:
Entity Resolution and Information Quality presents topics and definitions, and clarifies confusing terminologies regarding entity resolution and information quality. It takes a very wide view of IQ, including its six-domain framework and the skills formed by the International Association for Information and Data Quality {IAIDQ). The book includes chapters that cover the principles of entity resolution and the principles of Information Quality, in addition to their concepts and terminology. It also discusses the Fellegi-Sunter theory of record linkage, the Stanford Entity Resolution Framework, and the Algebraic Model for Entity Resolution, which are the major theoretical models that support Entity Resolution. In relation to this, the book briefly discusses entity-based data integration (EBDI) and its model, which serve as an extension of the Algebraic Model for Entity Resolution. There is also an explanation of how the three commercial ER systems operate and a description of the non-commercial open-source system known as OYSTER. The book concludes by discussing trends in entity resolution research and practice. Students taking IT courses and IT professionals will find this book invaluable.
First authoritative reference explaining entity resolution and how to use it effectively
Provides practical system design advice to help you get a competitive advantage
Includes a companion site with synthetic customer data for applicatory exercises, and access to a Java-based Entity Resolution program.

Resolución de Entidades e Información Calidad presenta temas y definiciones, y aclara terminologías confusas en cuanto a resolución de entidad y calidad de la información. Tiene una visión muy amplia del IQ, incluyendo su marco de seis dominios y las habilidades formadas por la Asociación Internacional de Información y Calidad de Datos {IAIDQ). El libro incluye capítulos que abarcan los principios de resolución de las entidades y los principios de calidad de la información, además de sus conceptos y terminología. También discute la teoría Fellegi-Sunter de la vinculación récord, el Marco de Resolución de Entidades de Stanford, y el Modelo Algebraico de Resolución de Entidades, que son los principales modelos teóricos que apoyan la Resolución de Entidades. En relación con esto, el libro analiza brevemente la integración de datos basados en la entidad (EBDI) y su modelo, que sirven como una extensión del modelo algebraico para la resolución de la Entidad. También hay una explicación de cómo funcionan los tres sistemas comerciales de ER y una descripción del sistema de código abierto no comercial conocido como OYSTER. El libro concluye discutiendo tendencias en investigación y práctica de resolución de entidades. Los estudiantes que toman cursos de TI y profesionales de TI encontrarán este libro invaluable.
Primera referencia autorizada que explica la resolución de la entidad y cómo utilizarla eficazmente
Proporciona consejos prácticos de diseño del sistema para ayudarle a obtener una ventaja competitiva
Incluye un sitio de acompañantes con datos de clientes sintéticos para ejercicios applicatory y acceso a un programa Java-based Entity Resolution.

title: Multiple Imputation of Missing Data Using SAS
description:
Find guidance on using SAS for multiple imputation and solving common missing data issues.

Multiple Imputation of Missing Data Using SAS provides both theoretical background and constructive solutions for those working with incomplete data sets in an engaging example-driven format. It offers practical instruction on the use of SAS for multiple imputation and provides numerous examples that use a variety of public release data sets with applications to survey data.

Written for users with an intermediate background in SAS programming and statistics, this book is an excellent resource for anyone seeking guidance on multiple imputation. The authors cover the MI and MIANALYZE procedures in detail, along with other procedures used for analysis of complete data sets. They guide analysts through the multiple imputation process, including evaluation of missing data patterns, choice of an imputation method, execution of the process, and interpretation of results.

Topics discussed include how to deal with missing data problems in a statistically appropriate manner, how to intelligently select an imputation method, how to incorporate the uncertainty introduced by the imputation process, and how to incorporate the complex sample design (if appropriate) through use of the SAS SURVEY procedures.

Discover the theoretical background and see extensive applications of the multiple imputation process in action.

This book is part of the SAS Press program.

Encuentre orientación sobre el uso de SAS para múltiples imputaciones y resolver problemas comunes de datos perdidos.

Multiple Imputation of Missing Data Usando SAS proporciona tanto antecedentes teóricos como soluciones constructivas para aquellos que trabajan con conjuntos de datos incompletos en un formato basado en ejemplo atractivo. Ofrece instrucción práctica sobre el uso de SAS para múltiples imputaciones y ofrece numerosos ejemplos que utilizan una variedad de conjuntos de datos de liberación pública con aplicaciones para encuestar datos.

Escrito para usuarios con antecedentes intermedios en programación y estadísticas de SAS, este libro es un excelente recurso para cualquiera que busque orientación sobre múltiples imputaciones. Los autores cubren detalladamente los procedimientos MI y MIANALYZE, junto con otros procedimientos utilizados para el análisis de conjuntos completos de datos. Guían a los analistas a través del proceso de imputación múltiple, incluyendo la evaluación de patrones de datos perdidos, elección de un método de imputación, ejecución del proceso, e interpretación de resultados.

Los temas tratados incluyen cómo tratar los problemas de datos desaparecidos de manera estadísticamente apropiada, cómo seleccionar inteligentemente un método de imputación, cómo incorporar la incertidumbre introducida por el proceso de imputación, y cómo incorporar el complejo diseño de muestra (si es apropiado) mediante el uso de los procedimientos SAS SURVEY.

Descubra el fondo teórico y vea extensas aplicaciones del proceso de imputación múltiple en acción.

title: Ethics of Big Data
description:
This book contains a framework for productive discussion and thinking about ethics and Big Data in business environments.

With the increasing size and scope of information that Big Data technologies can provide business, maintaining an ethical practice benefits from a common framework of understanding and vocabulary for discussing questions about coherent and consistent practices.

A framework provides you with a set of conceptual terms and tools that help decision-markers to engage difficult questions the expanding role Big Data plays in an increasing variety of products and services. The approach is to develop a set of terms and concepts, consider ethical principles useful in meaningful business discussions, and then explore and compare several overall views on data handling to help inform the development of an ethics-based data strategy.

The focus is to enhance effective decision-making in business rather than legislate what ought to be done with data. In this book, you will learn methods and techniques to facilitate rigorous, productive internal discussion, and express coherent and consistent positions on your organization's perspective on the use of Big Data in commerce.

Un marco le proporciona un conjunto de términos y herramientas conceptuales que ayudan a los marcadores de decisiones a involucrar preguntas difíciles el papel de expansión Big Data juega en una creciente variedad de productos y servicios. title: Getting Your Data Ready for AI
description:
Despite the enthusiasm for AI, a recent survey reveals that few organizations have adopted this technology in any meaningful way. One reason is the tedious process of accessing, labeling, and transforming data—known as data wrangling—that consumes 80% of a data scientist’s time. There’s a better way to model data. This practical ebook explores a new crop of self-service data preparation tools and services, including IBM Watson Studio, for automating data wrangling.

Featuring interviews with data analytics experts, including Alex Castrounis (InnoArchiTech), Jay Limburn (IBM), and Katharine Jarmul (Data Wrangling with Python) among others, this ebook examines key barriers to capturing value from AI processes, including problems with data access and preparation. Author Kate Shoup shows data scientists and analysts how Watson Studio and other self-service tools enable domain experts, developers, and business analysts to practice data science.

Get an overview of data science and learn how it differs from data analysis
Examine a typical AI workflow, including challenges that surface at each step of the data wrangling process
Learn solutions to AI workflow challenges, including the use of data catalogs to help you access and prep data
Dive into Watson Studio and learn how the platform combines data catalogs with support for data science tools in one environment
Evaluate a Watson Studio example and explore real-world use cases

Este práctico ebook explora un nuevo cultivo de herramientas y servicios de preparación de datos de autoservicio, incluyendo IBM Watson Studio, para automatizar el tratamiento de datos.

Examinar un flujo de trabajo típico de IA, incluyendo desafíos que surgen a cada paso del proceso de tratamiento de datos
Aprenda soluciones a los retos del flujo de trabajo de AI, incluyendo el uso de catálogos de datos para ayudarle a acceder y preparar datos

Evaluar un ejemplo de Watson Studio y explorar casos de uso en el mundo real

title: Microsoft SQL Server 2012 Performance Tuning Cookbook
description:
If you've ever faced a sluggish application running on SQL Server 2012, this book is your go-to resource for resolving such issues. Diving deep into performance monitoring, tuning, and management, this cookbook provides concise, practical recipes to help you diagnose, improve, and maintain database performance effectively.

What this Book will help me do

Develop skills in monitoring SQL Server performance using tools like SQL Profiler and Execution Plans.
Learn to diagnose bottlenecks and optimize system resources for better database efficiency.
Acquire methods for effective indexing and query tuning to ensure fast application response.
Understand techniques to prevent and resolve concurrency issues such as deadlocks.
Master the management of database performance with tools like Policy-Based Management and Resource Governor.

Author(s)

The author(s) bring a wealth of experience in database administration and optimization for SQL Server environments. They have extensive backgrounds in addressing performance challenges and crafting efficient solutions. Their approachable and informative writing style ensures that even complex topics are accessible. Passionate about empowering professionals, the author(s) aim to provide actionable insights and practical approaches.

Who is it for?

This book is tailored for SQL Server Database Developers, Database Administrators, and Database Architects seeking to enhance their performance tuning skills. It is ideal for professionals who understand SQL Server basics but wish to dive deeper into performance optimization. Readers aiming to identify and resolve performance challenges in their SQL Server 2012 systems will greatly benefit. Whether you're an experienced professional or newly involved in SQL tuning, this book has valuable insights to offer.

title: Mastering Predictive Analytics with scikit-learn and TensorFlow
description:
Mastering Predictive Analytics with scikit-learn and TensorFlow is a practical guide to leveraging Python for advanced machine learning tasks. Through this book, you'll explore ensemble learning, dimensionality reduction, and delve deep into the creation and application of neural networks using TensorFlow. By mastering these tools and techniques, you'll be equipped to tackle real-world predictive analytics challenges effectively.

What this Book will help me do

Gain expertise in applying ensemble methods to enhance model accuracy in predictive analytics.
Understand the principles and application of dimensionality reduction techniques for better model performance.
Learn efficient cross-validation methods to select optimal hyperparameters.
Master the creation and use of neural network models using TensorFlow for classification and regression problems.
Develop the ability to implement advanced predictive analytics in Python for solving real-world data challenges.

Author(s)

Alvaro Fuentes is a data scientist with extensive experience in Python-based machine learning and predictive analytics. With a strong technical background, Alvaro has successfully applied his expertise to solve numerous data challenges in professional settings. He brings a hands-on, clear teaching approach to help readers learn and implement advanced techniques.

Who is it for?

This book is tailored for data analysts, machine learning engineers, software developers, and business intelligence professionals. It benefits those with foundational knowledge of Python and basic understanding of predictive analytics, who aim to advance their skills towards building sophisticated predictive models. Ideal readers are those seeking to enhance their data analytics proficiency with state-of-the-art tools.

¿Para quién es?

Presta atención a aquellos con conocimientos fundamentales de Python y comprensión básica de la analítica predictiva, que buscan avanzar en sus habilidades hacia la construcción de modelos predictivos sofisticados. Los lectores ideales son aquellos que buscan mejorar su competencia de análisis de datos con herramientas de última generación.

title: Oracle DBA Pocket Guide
description:
The Oracle database is one of the most popular in the world, and for good reason. It's compatible, scalable, portable, and capable of performing incredibly fast. The advantages Oracle holds over its competition come with a price, however--it's a highly complex database that's becoming more complex with every release. And this level of detail, of course, can begin to weigh on database administrators (DBAs).

Fortunately, the Oracle DBA Pocket Guide from O'Reilly is on the case. This handy reference is designed to help administrators make more effective use of their time by presenting a compact summary of DBA tasks in an easy-to-use form. With this book by your side, you'll have instant access to the most important concepts, best practices, tips, and checklists. Key topics include architecture, installation, configuration, tuning, and backup/recovery. Everything that you absolutely must know to do your job well is right there at your fingertips.

Moreover, the Oracle DBA Pocket Guide covers Oracle Database 9i, as well as its latest release, Oracle Database 10g. The first database designed for enterprising grid computing, Oracle Database 10g significantly reduces the cost of managing the IT environment with a simplified install, reduced configuration and management requirements, and automatic performance diagnosis and SQL tuning.

The latest in O'Reilly's line of bestselling Oracle titles, this book is an invaluable companion for any database administrator--new or experienced--interested in reviewing core Oracle concepts at a glance.
translatedDescription:
La base de datos Oracle es una de las más populares del mundo, y por buena razón. Es compatible, escalable, portátil y capaz de realizar increíblemente rápido. Las ventajas que Oracle tiene sobre su competencia vienen con un precio, sin embargo, es una base de datos altamente compleja que se está volviendo más compleja con cada lanzamiento. Y este nivel de detalle, por supuesto, puede comenzar a pesar en los administradores de bases de datos (DBAs).

Afortunadamente, el Oracle DBA Pocket Guide de O'Reilly está en el caso. Esta referencia práctica está diseñada para ayudar a los administradores a hacer un uso más eficaz de su tiempo presentando un resumen compacto de las tareas de DBA en un formulario fácil de usar. Con este libro a tu lado, tendrás acceso instantáneo a los conceptos más importantes, mejores prácticas, consejos y listas de verificación. Los temas clave incluyen arquitectura, instalación, configuración, sintonización y respaldo/recuperación. Todo lo que debes saber para hacer bien tu trabajo está justo ahí a tu alcance.

Además, la Guía Oracle DBA Pocket cubre Oracle Database 9i, así como su última versión, Oracle Database 10g. La primera base de datos diseñada para la computación inicial de la red, Oracle Database 10g reduce significativamente el costo de gestionar el entorno de TI con una instalación simplificada, reducción de los requisitos de configuración y gestión, y diagnóstico de rendimiento automático y ajuste SQL.

Lo último en la línea de O'Reilly de títulos de Oracle bestselling, este libro es un compañero invaluable para cualquier administrador de bases de datos -nueva o experimentada- interesado en revisar conceptos básicos de Oracle de un vistazo.

title: AutomationML
description:
This book is a beginner's guide to AutomationML Edition 2, written for students, engineers, lecturers, developers and those interested. In guides through the basics of AutomationML Edition 2, CAEX and the AutomationML Editor. AutomationML stands for digitisation of engineering data and engineering workflows. AutomationML achieves both human readability and machine-readability. It is a method for converting data into digital information, and it supports the special needs of iterative engineering data exchange. AutomationML is in the hot spot of the digitisation of automation engineering data. It enables the modelling and transport of engineering data in a vendor neutral and machine-readable models, a valuable source of digital innovation. Machine readable engineering data makes the data accessible and interpretable by software, enabling a plethora of opportunities. This book carefully introduces AutomationML, its goals, values and innovations. It teaches the architecture of AutomationML and explains the language elements with a multitude of examples and step-by-step instructions.

Additional material to the book and more information about AutomationML on the website: https://www.automationml.org/about-automationml/publications/amlbook/
translatedDescription:

AutomationML logra la legibilidad humana y la legibilidad de la máquina. Es un método para convertir datos en información digital, y soporta las necesidades especiales del intercambio de datos de ingeniería iterativa. AutomationML está en el punto caliente de la digitalización de datos de ingeniería de automatización. Permite modelar y transportar datos de ingeniería en modelos neutrales y legibles para proveedores, una valiosa fuente de innovación digital. Los datos de ingeniería legible por máquina hacen que los datos sean accesibles e interpretables por software, permitiendo una gran cantidad de oportunidades. Este libro presenta cuidadosamente AutomationML, sus objetivos, valores e innovaciones. Enseña la arquitectura de AutomationML y explica los elementos del lenguaje con multitud de ejemplos e instrucciones paso a paso.

Material adicional al libro y más información sobre AutomationML en el sitio web: https://www.automationml.org/about-automationml/publications/amlbook/

title: Advanced Deep Learning with Keras
description:
Dive into the world of advanced AI development with "Advanced Deep Learning with Keras". This book takes you through cutting-edge techniques such as autoencoders, GANs, VAEs, and reinforcement learning, empowering you to build sophisticated AI systems with Keras and TensorFlow. With practical examples, you'll gain hands-on experience building models that achieve state-of-the-art performance.

What this Book will help me do

Understand advanced deep learning principles, including autoencoders, GANs, and VAEs.
Implement deep learning models using Keras and TensorFlow, leveraging advanced architectures like ResNet.
Develop skills to apply GANs and VAEs for generative model tasks.
Master reinforcement learning algorithms, including Deep Q-Learning and Policy Gradient Methods.
Enhance your ability to create high-performance AI products for practical and innovative applications.

Author(s)

Rowel Atienza is a leading researcher and professor specializing in deep learning and AI technologies. With years of experience in both academia and industry, he brings deep technical expertise and a clear teaching methodology to this book. He is devoted to empowering learners and professionals alike to explore advanced deep learning techniques.

Who is it for?

This book is designed for developers and data scientists who have foundational knowledge of machine learning and python programming. If you're looking to extend your understanding into deep learning architectures and practical AI implementations, this book is for you. Familiarity with concepts like CNNs or RNNs is helpful, but the book is accessible even if Keras or TensorFlow are new to you.

title: Learning Tableau 2019 - Third Edition
description:
Discover how to harness the power of Tableau 2019 to transform raw data into insightful, actionable business intelligence. This book serves as a comprehensive guide to mastering Tableau's features-from creating stunning visualizations to managing complex datasets with Tableau Prep. By the end, you'll be well-equipped to use Tableau for informed decision-making.

What this Book will help me do

Master the essential features of Tableau 2019 to become proficient in data visualization.
Learn to prepare and integrate data effectively using Tableau Prep.
Develop advanced visual analytics skills, including calculations and table calculations.
Understand how to craft compelling dashboards and data stories for impactful communication.
Leverage new Tableau features like set actions and transparent views for enhanced analytics.

Author(s)

Joshua N. Milligan is a Tableau-certified professional and Tableau Zen Master with extensive industry experience in data analytics. Known for his clarity in teaching, Joshua takes a practical and comprehensive approach to help users navigate Tableau effectively. His passion for empowering data-driven decisions is evident in his writing.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for data professionals, analysts, or anyone new to Tableau who seeks to gain proficiency in data visualization and analysis. It is suitable for beginners, as it walks the reader through foundational concepts before introducing complex topics. Readers looking to enhance their skills in advanced Tableau techniques will also find value here. Familiarity with databases is helpful but not mandatory.

Al final, estará bien equipado para usar Tableau para tomar decisiones informadas.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Domine las características esenciales de Tableau 2019 para ser eficientes en la visualización de datos.
Aprende a preparar e integrar datos eficazmente utilizando Tableau Prep.

title: Implementing NFSv4 in the Enterprise: Planning and Migration Strategies
description:
The most recent maintenance release of IBM AIX 5L Version 5.3 includes a significant set of new features added to the NFSv4 implementation. In 2004, the first IBM Redbooks publication devoted to the topic of NFSv4 implementation in AIX 5L was published: "Securing NFS in AIX: An Introduction to NFS V4 in AIX 5L," SG24-7204.

This book provides additional up-to-date information to help IBM clients understand and take advantage of the new NFSv4 functions provided by AIX 5L Version 5.3 with the 5300-03 Recommended Maintenance Package.

The NFSv4 implementation in AIX 5L has now expanded to provide core features that make it capable of providing a much broader range of distributed file system services than any prior version of NFS. The scope of this book includes methods for implementing NFSv4 in the enterprise and extensive coverage of methods for how it can potentially be used as a migration target for existing AFS-based and DCE/DFS-based enterprise file systems.

Please note that the additional material referenced in the text is not available from IBM.
translatedDescription:
La versión 5.3 de mantenimiento más reciente de IBM AIX 5L incluye un conjunto significativo de nuevas características agregadas a la implementación NFSv4. En 2004, se publicó la primera publicación IBM Redbooks dedicada al tema de la implementación NFSv4 en AIX 5L: "Securing NFS in AIX: An Introduction to NFS V4 in AIX 5L", SG24-7204.

Este libro proporciona información adicional actualizada para ayudar a los clientes de IBM a comprender y aprovechar las nuevas funciones NFSv4 proporcionadas por AIX 5L Versión 5.3 con el paquete de mantenimiento recomendado 5300-03.

La implementación NFSv4 en AIX 5L se ha ampliado para proporcionar características básicas que lo hacen capaz de proporcionar una gama mucho más amplia de servicios de sistemas de archivos distribuidos que cualquier versión anterior de NFS. El alcance de este libro incluye métodos para implementar NFSv4 en la empresa y una amplia cobertura de métodos para cómo se puede utilizar potencialmente como objetivo de migración para los sistemas de archivos institucionales basados en AFS y DCE/DFS existentes.

Tenga en cuenta que el material adicional mencionado en el texto no está disponible en el IBM.

title: Machine Learning and IoT for Intelligent Systems and Smart Applications
description: This book discusses algorithmic applications in the field of machine learning and IOT with pertinent applications. It further discusses challenges and future directions in the machine learning area and develops understanding of its role in technology, in terms of IoT security issues. It includes pertinent applications and case studies.

Incluye solicitudes pertinentes y estudios de casos.

title: Principles of Big Data
description:
Principles of Big Data helps readers avoid the common mistakes that endanger all Big Data projects. By stressing simple, fundamental concepts, this book teaches readers how to organize large volumes of complex data, and how to achieve data permanence when the content of the data is constantly changing. General methods for data verification and validation, as specifically applied to Big Data resources, are stressed throughout the book. The book demonstrates how adept analysts can find relationships among data objects held in disparate Big Data resources, when the data objects are endowed with semantic support (i.e., organized in classes of uniquely identified data objects). Readers will learn how their data can be integrated with data from other resources, and how the data extracted from Big Data resources can be used for purposes beyond those imagined by the data creators.

Learn general methods for specifying Big Data in a way that is understandable to humans and to computers
Avoid the pitfalls in Big Data design and analysis
Understand how to create and use Big Data safely and responsibly with a set of laws, regulations and ethical standards that apply to the acquisition, distribution and integration of Big Data resources
translatedDescription:
Principios de Big Data ayuda a los lectores a evitar los errores comunes que ponen en peligro todos los proyectos Big Data. Destacando conceptos simples y fundamentales, este libro enseña a los lectores cómo organizar grandes volúmenes de datos complejos, y cómo lograr la permanencia de los datos cuando el contenido de los datos está cambiando constantemente. En todo el libro se destacan los métodos generales de verificación y validación de datos, aplicados específicamente a los recursos de Big Data. El libro demuestra cómo los analistas adeptos pueden encontrar relaciones entre los objetos de datos mantenidos en recursos de Big Data dispares, cuando los objetos de datos están dotados de soporte semántico (es decir, organizados en clases de objetos de datos identificados de forma única). Los lectores aprenderán cómo sus datos pueden integrarse con datos de otros recursos, y cómo los datos extraídos de los recursos de Big Data pueden utilizarse para fines más allá de los imaginados por los creadores de datos.

Aprende métodos generales para especificar Big Data de una manera comprensible para los seres humanos y para las computadoras
Evite los obstáculos en el diseño y análisis de Big Data
Entender cómo crear y utilizar Big Data de manera segura y responsable con un conjunto de leyes, regulaciones y normas éticas que se aplican a la adquisición, distribución e integración de los recursos Big Data

title: Modeling and Analysis of Compositional Data
description:
Modeling and Analysis of Compositional Data presents a practical and comprehensive introduction to the analysis of compositional data along with numerous examples to illustrate both theory and application of each method. Based upon short courses delivered by the authors, it provides a complete and current compendium of fundamental to advanced methodologies along with exercises at the end of each chapter to improve understanding, as well as data and a solutions manual which is available on an accompanying website.

Complementing Pawlowsky-Glahn's earlier collective text that provides an overview of the state-of-the-art in this field, Modeling and Analysis of Compositional Data fills a gap in the literature for a much-needed manual for teaching, self learning or consulting.
translatedDescription:
Modeling and Analysis of Compositional Data presenta una introducción práctica y completa al análisis de datos compositivos junto con numerosos ejemplos para ilustrar tanto la teoría como la aplicación de cada método. Basándose en cursos cortos impartidos por los autores, proporciona un compendio completo y actual de metodologías fundamentales a avanzadas, junto con ejercicios al final de cada capítulo para mejorar la comprensión, así como datos y un manual de soluciones que está disponible en un sitio web acompañante.

Complementando el texto colectivo anterior de Pawlowsky-Glahn que proporciona una visión general del estado de arte en este campo, Modeling and Analysis of Compositional Data llena una brecha en la literatura para un manual muy necesario para la enseñanza, el autoaprendizaje o la consultoría.

title: IBM i 7.1 Technical Overview with Technology Refresh Updates
description:
This IBM® Redbooks® publication provides a technical overview of the features, functions, and enhancements available in IBM i 7.1, including all the Technology Refresh (TR) levels from TR1 to TR7. It provides a summary and brief explanation of the many capabilities and functions in the operating system. It also describes many of the licensed programs and application development tools that are associated with IBM i.

The information provided in this book is useful for clients, IBM Business Partners, and IBM service professionals who are involved with planning, supporting, upgrading, and implementing IBM i 7.1 solutions.

Proporciona un resumen y una breve explicación de las muchas capacidades y funciones del sistema operativo. También describe muchos de los programas licenciados y herramientas de desarrollo de aplicaciones que están asociados con IBM i.

La información proporcionada en este libro es útil para clientes, IBM Business Partners y profesionales de servicios de IBM que están involucrados en la planificación, el apoyo, la mejora y la implementación de soluciones IBM i 7.1.

title: Mathematica DeMYSTiFied
description:
Need to learn MATHEMATICA? Problem SOLVED!

Take full advantage of all the powerful capabilities of Mathematica with help from this hands-on guide. Filled with examples and step-by-step explanations, Mathematica Demystified takes you from your very first calculation all the way to plotting complex fractals.

Using an intuitive format, this book explains the fundamentals of Mathematica up front. Learn how to define functions, create 2-D graphs of functions, write basic programs, and use modules. You'll move on to 3-D graphics, calculus, polynomial, linear, and differential equations, dynamical systems, and fractals. Hundreds of examples with concise explanations make it easy to understand the material, and end-of-chapter quizzes and a final exam help reinforce learning.

This self-teaching guide offers:

A quick way to get up and running on Mathematica
Coverage of Mathematica 6 and 7
Tips for avoiding and correcting syntax errors
Details on creating slideshow presentations of your work
No unnecessary technical jargon
A time-saving approach to performing better on an exam or at work!

Simple enough for a beginner, but challenging enough for an advanced user, Mathematica Demystified is your shortcut to mastering this fully integrated technical computing software.

¿Necesitas aprender MATHEMATICA? ¡Problema resuelto!

Usando un formato intuitivo, este libro explica los fundamentos de Mathematica delante. Aprende a definir funciones, crear gráficos 2-D de funciones, escribir programas básicos y utilizar módulos. Un enfoque de ahorro de tiempo para realizar mejor en un examen o en el trabajo!

title: XSLT 1.0 Pocket Reference
description:
XSLT is an essential tool for converting XML into other kinds of documents: HTML, PDF file, and many others. It's a critical technology for XML-based platforms such as Microsoft .NET, Sun Microsystems' Sun One, as well as for most web browsers and authoring tools. As useful as XSLT is, however, most people have a difficult time getting used to its peculiar characteristics. The ability to use advanced techniques depends on a clear and exact understanding of how XSLT templates work and interact.

The XSLT 1.0 Pocket Reference from O'Reilly wants to make sure you achieve that level of understanding. With its concise approach, this handy pocket guide quickly gets you up to speed on XSLT 1.0 so you can covert XML like a seasoned pro. In addition to covering the basics of stylesheet structure, it also explains how to:

use template rules
create a result tree
apply conditional processing
transform multiple source documents
employ number formatting

Thanks to their convenient, quick-reference format, O'Reilly's Pocket References spare you from having to hunt through larger books for answers. They deliver just what you need to get the job done in a timely fashion. And the XSLT 1.0 Pocket Reference is no different--it's the ideal companion to have at your desk when you need an answer fast.

title: Risk Assessment and Decision Analysis with Bayesian Networks
description:
Although many Bayesian Network (BN) applications are now in everyday use, BNs have not yet achieved mainstream penetration. Focusing on practical real-world problem solving and model building, as opposed to algorithms and theory, Risk Assessment and Decision Analysis with Bayesian Networks explains how to incorporate knowledge with data to develop and use (Bayesian) causal models of risk that provide powerful insights and better decision making.

Provides all tools necessary to build and run realistic Bayesian network models
Supplies extensive example models based on real risk assessment problems in a wide range of application domains provided; for example, finance, safety, systems reliability, law, and more
Introduces all necessary mathematics, probability, and statistics as needed

The book first establishes the basics of probability, risk, and building and using BN models, then goes into the detailed applications. The underlying BN algorithms appear in appendices rather than the main text since there is no need to understand them to build and use BN models. Keeping the body of the text free of intimidating mathematics, the book provides pragmatic advice about model building to ensure models are built efficiently.

A dedicated website, www.BayesianRisk.com, contains executable versions of all of the models described, exercises and worked solutions for all chapters, PowerPoint slides, numerous other resources, and a free downloadable copy of the AgenaRisk software.
translatedDescription:
Aunque muchas aplicaciones de Bayesian Network (BN) están ahora en uso cotidiano, los BN aún no han logrado la penetración principal. Centrarse en la solución práctica de problemas en el mundo real y la construcción de modelos, en lugar de algoritmos y teorías, Evaluación de Riesgos y Análisis de Decisiones con Bayesian Networks explica cómo incorporar conocimiento con datos para desarrollar y utilizar modelos causales de riesgo (Bayesian) que proporcionan ideas poderosas y mejor toma de decisiones.

Proporciona todas las herramientas necesarias para construir y ejecutar modelos realistas de red Bayesian
Suponga modelos de ejemplo extensos basados en problemas reales de evaluación de riesgos en una amplia gama de dominios de aplicaciones proporcionados; por ejemplo, finanzas, seguridad, fiabilidad de sistemas, ley y más
Introduce todas las matemáticas, probabilidad y estadísticas necesarias

El libro primero establece los fundamentos de probabilidad, riesgo y construcción y uso de modelos BN, luego entra en las aplicaciones detalladas. Los algoritmos BN subyacentes aparecen en apéndices en lugar del texto principal ya que no hay necesidad de entenderlos para construir y utilizar modelos BN. Manteniendo el cuerpo del texto libre de intimidar las matemáticas, el libro proporciona consejos pragmáticos sobre la construcción de modelos para asegurar que los modelos se construyen eficientemente.

Un sitio web dedicado, www.BayesianRisk.com, contiene versiones ejecutables de todos los modelos descritos, ejercicios y soluciones trabajadas para todos los capítulos, diapositivas de PowerPoint, muchos otros recursos, y una copia descargable gratuita del software AgenaRisk.

title: Hands-On Deep Learning with R
description:
"Hands-On Deep Learning with R" equips you with the practical tools and techniques to design, build, and optimize neural network models using R programming. With clear explanations, practical examples, and step-by-step guides, this book makes complex deep learning concepts accessible for R developers who wish to advance their skills.

What this Book will help me do

Develop skills to design and optimize various neural network architectures and accurately solve problems.
Build convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for tasks like image recognition and predictive analytics.
Master techniques to preprocess and transform data for effective machine learning model training.
Implement advanced models such as generative adversarial networks (GANs) for creative applications like face generation.
Understand reinforcement learning concepts and apply them to solve real-world scenarios efficiently.

Author(s)

Rodger Devine and None Pawlus bring years of experience in machine learning, data science, and R programming. Rodger has a rich history in applying technical solutions to practical problems, while None brings in-depth knowledge in creating approachable guides for learners of all levels. Together, they deliver a clear and practice-oriented guide to deep learning with R.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for data scientists, machine learning practitioners, and developers familiar with R who are interested in leveraging deep learning. Whether you are refining your skills or exploring how to use R for deep learning solutions, this book provides the practical techniques and insights you need to succeed.
translatedDescription:
"Hands-On Deep Learning with R" le equipa con las herramientas y técnicas prácticas para diseñar, construir y optimizar modelos de red neuronales utilizando la programación R. Con explicaciones claras, ejemplos prácticos y guías paso a paso, este libro hace que complejos conceptos de aprendizaje profundo sean accesibles para los desarrolladores R que deseen avanzar en sus habilidades.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Desarrollar habilidades para diseñar y optimizar diversas arquitecturas de red neuronales y resolver con precisión los problemas.
Construir redes neuronales convolutivas (CNN) para tareas como reconocimiento de imagen y analítica predictiva.
Técnicas maestras para preprocesar y transformar datos para la formación eficaz del modelo de aprendizaje automático.
Implementar modelos avanzados como redes contradictorias generativas (GAN) para aplicaciones creativas como la generación de rostros.
Comprender conceptos de aprendizaje de refuerzo y aplicarlos para resolver escenarios del mundo real de manera eficiente.

Autor(s)

Rodger Devine y Ninguno Pawlus aportan años de experiencia en el aprendizaje automático, la ciencia de datos y la programación R. Rodger tiene una rica historia en la aplicación de soluciones técnicas a problemas prácticos, mientras que Ninguno aporta conocimientos profundos en la creación de guías accesibles para los estudiantes de todos los niveles. Juntos, ofrecen una guía clara y orientada a la práctica para el aprendizaje profundo con R.

¿Para quién es?

Este libro es ideal para científicos de datos, practicantes de aprendizaje automático y desarrolladores familiares con R que están interesados en aprovechar el aprendizaje profundo. Si está refinando sus habilidades o explorando cómo utilizar R para soluciones de aprendizaje profundo, este libro proporciona las técnicas prácticas y las ideas que necesita para tener éxito.

title: Introducing ArcGIS API 4 for JavaScript: Turn Awesome Maps into Awesome Apps
description:
Learn to use the ArcGIS API 4 for JavaScript to build custom web mapping applications. This book teaches you to easily create interactive displays of geographic information that you can use to tell stories and answer questions. 

Version 4 of the ArcGIS API for JavaScript introduces new patterns and fundamental concepts, including 3D mapping capabilities. You will learn the fundamentals of using the API in order to get the most out of it. Covering key concepts and how different components work together, you will also learn how to take advantage of the Widget framework built into the API to build your own reusable widgets for your own ArcGIS JSAPI applications.

Including a series of samples you can use to leverage the API for your own applications, Introducing ArcGIS API 4 for JavaScript helps you take your existing knowledge of JavaScript to a new level, and add new features to your app libraries.

What You'll Learn

Create both 2D and 3D custom web mapping applications
Work with popups and custom widgets
Leverage the ArcGIS platform in your applications
Utilize custom visualizations

Who This Book Is For

Developers who need to learn the ArcGIS JSAPI for work or school. 

Those with some JavaScript experience; GIS or mapping experience is not required.
translatedDescription:
Aprende a utilizar el ArcGIS API 4 para JavaScript para crear aplicaciones de mapeo web personalizadas. Este libro te enseña a crear fácilmente pantallas interactivas de información geográfica que puedes usar para contar historias y responder preguntas.

La versión 4 de la API ArcGIS para JavaScript introduce nuevos patrones y conceptos fundamentales, incluyendo capacidades de mapeo 3D. Usted aprenderá los fundamentos de usar la API para sacar el máximo provecho de ella. Cubrir conceptos clave y cómo funcionan los diferentes componentes juntos, también aprenderá cómo aprovechar el marco Widget incorporado en la API para construir sus propios widgets reutilizables para sus propias aplicaciones ArcGIS JSAPI.

Incluyendo una serie de muestras que puede utilizar para aprovechar la API para sus propias aplicaciones, la introducción de ArcGIS API 4 para JavaScript le ayuda a tomar su conocimiento existente de JavaScript a un nuevo nivel, y añadir nuevas características a sus bibliotecas de aplicaciones.

Lo que aprenderás

Crear aplicaciones de mapeo web personalizadas 2D y 3D
Trabajar con popups y widgets personalizados
Aproveche la plataforma ArcGIS en sus aplicaciones
Utilizar visualizaciones personalizadas

Quién es este libro

Desarrolladores que necesitan aprender el ArcGIS JSAPI para el trabajo o la escuela.

Aquellos con alguna experiencia de JavaScript; SIG o experiencia de mapeo no es necesario.

title: TensorFlow Deep Learning Projects
description:
Embark on an engaging journey into TensorFlow deep learning by exploring 10 practical projects that focus on real-world challenges. This book will guide you through mastering TensorFlow tools and models for innovative projects such as creating chatbots, predicting stock prices, and developing AI that plays video games. You'll deepen your skills and build functional systems to solve complex problems.

What this Book will help me do

Understand how to set up TensorFlow for efficient deep learning workflows.
Build convolutional neural networks for advancements in image recognition projects.
Develop chatbots powered by deep neural networks to provide natural language responses.
Implement advanced LSTM models for accurate time series forecasting and text processing.
Experiment with GANs to create synthetic data and novel image creation capabilities.

Author(s)

Alexey Grigorev and None Shanmugamani are seasoned machine learning practitioners and educators. Alexey focuses on data science and deep learning solutions for complex problems, while None specializes in TensorFlow-powered AI systems. Together, they bring practical experience and an accessible teaching style to this book.

Who is it for?

This book is ideal for data scientists, machine learning developers, and deep learning practitioners with a basic grasp of TensorFlow who aspire to enhance their expertise. It's designed for those interested in hands-on projects that connect the theory of deep learning to practical applications. Readers should have foundational knowledge of machine learning principles to fully benefit from the book.
translatedDescription:
Embarque en un viaje atractivo hacia TensorFlow aprendizaje profundo explorando 10 proyectos prácticos que se centran en los desafíos del mundo real. Este libro te guiará a través de herramientas y modelos TensorFlow para proyectos innovadores como crear chatbots, predecir precios de stock y desarrollar AI que juega videojuegos. Profundizarás tus habilidades y construirás sistemas funcionales para resolver problemas complejos.

Lo que este libro me ayudará a hacer

Entender cómo configurar TensorFlow para flujos de trabajo de aprendizaje profundo eficientes.
Construir redes neuronales convolutivas para avances en proyectos de reconocimiento de imágenes.
Desarrollar chatbots alimentados por redes neuronales profundas para proporcionar respuestas de lenguaje natural.
Implementar modelos LSTM avanzados para previsiones precisas de series de tiempo y procesamiento de texto.
Experimente con GANs para crear datos sintéticos y nuevas capacidades de creación de imagen.

Autor(s)

Alexey Grigorev y Ninguno Shanmugamani son expertos en el aprendizaje de máquinas y educadores.
